quiz.explanation: 一边倒的，一边倒的比分。The game ended with a lopsided score of 50 to 10. 比赛以50比10的一边倒的比分结束。 | lop->垂下，sided->边，lopsided->一边垂下的=不平衡的（cf. one-sided片面的，skewed歪斜的，unbalanced不平衡的） || 文化联想：中文“一边倒”几乎就是 lopsided 的现成联想：无论比赛、争论还是力量对比，只要明显偏向一边、严重不均衡，都可以说 lopsided，可以说 **a lopsided contest — “A 10–0 match is a lopsided contest because nearly all the advantage lies on one side.”**

quiz.question: backhanded __________
quiz.explanation: 挖苦的，挖苦的恭维。His backhanded compliment was actually an insult. 他挖苦的恭维实际上是侮辱。 | back->背，handed->手，backhanded->用手背的=反向的=表面赞美实为讽刺（cf. backhand反手，underhanded卑鄙，left-handed委婉讽刺） || 文化联想：“你最近胖了，看起来更有福气了”这种话表面像夸奖，里面却暗藏让人不舒服的意思，就是典型的 backhanded compliment；backhanded 强调明褒暗贬，可以说 **a backhanded compliment — “'You look much better now that you've gained some weight' can sound like a backhanded compliment.”**

quiz.question: evenhanded _________
quiz.explanation: 公正的，公正的对待。The judge provided evenhanded treatment to all parties. 法官对所有当事人提供公正的对待。 | even->平均，handed->手，evenhanded->两手相等的=公正的（cf. fair公平，impartial公正，unbiased无偏见，equitable公平） || 文化联想：“一碗水端平”最适合解释 evenhanded：对不同的人和双方都公平对待、不偏不倚，这正是 evenhanded（公正无私的）的核心，可以说 **evenhanded treatment — “'Keep the bowl of water level' is a vivid Chinese image for evenhanded treatment.”**

quiz.question: underhanded _______
quiz.explanation: 卑鄙的，卑鄙的手段。The competitor used underhanded tactics to win. 竞争对手使用卑鄙的手段获胜。 | under->在下，handed->手，underhanded->手在下面=秘密的=卑鄙的（cf. backhanded讽刺，underhand卑鄙，devious迂回/不正当） || 文化联想：“暗箭伤人”最适合联想到 underhanded：不是公开竞争，而是在背后使阴招、用见不得光的手段达到目的，正是 underhanded（卑鄙暗中的），可以说 **an underhanded tactic — “'Shooting an arrow from the dark' is a classic image of an underhanded tactic.”**

quiz.question: closed-minded ________
quiz.explanation: 固执己见的，固执己见的态度。His closed-minded attitude prevented him from learning. 他固执己见的态度阻止了他学习。 | closed->关闭，minded->心态，closed-minded->心扉关闭的=固执己见（cf. open-minded思想开放，narrow-minded心胸狭窄，broad-minded宽宏大量） || 文化联想：“固步自封”描述拒绝新观念、听不进不同意见的状态，很适合用 closed-minded 来形容；closed-minded 就是思想封闭、固执不肯接受新想法，可以说 **a closed-minded attitude — “Refusing to hear any new argument is a closed-minded attitude often summed up by the phrase 'resting on one's old ways.'”**

quiz.question: long-winded ______
quiz.explanation: 冗长的，冗长的演讲。The politician's long-winded speech bored the audience. 政客冗长的演讲让观众感到无聊。 | long->长，winded->呼吸，long-winded->呼吸长=说话冗长的（cf. verbose冗长，prolix啰嗦，wordy话多，tedious冗长乏味） || 文化联想：俗语“老太太的裹脚布——又臭又长”专门讽刺说话文章拖沓冗长，很适合解释 long-winded；它指说得太多、绕得太久，可以说 **a long-winded speech — “The saying about an old-style foot binding being 'smelly and long' is often used to mock a long-winded speech.”**

quiz.question: unfounded _____
quiz.explanation: 没有根据的，没有根据的谣言。The unfounded rumor spread quickly through the town. 没有根据的谣言在镇上迅速传播。 | un->否定，founded->建立，unfounded->没有建立在事实上的=无根据的（cf. groundless无根据，baseless无依据，unsubstantiated未经证实） || 文化联想：“捕风捉影”指没有可靠依据却硬说有其事，这正适合 unfounded；unfounded 的核心就是“没有事实或证据基础的”，可以说 **an unfounded rumor — “A rumor based only on hearsay and guesswork is an unfounded rumor.”**

quiz.question: ____ grounded
quiz.explanation: 有根据的，有充分根据的。Her theory was well grounded in scientific evidence. 她的理论有充分根据在科学证据上。 | ground->基础，grounded->有基础的，well-grounded->有充分基础的=有根据的（cf. well-founded有根有据，substantiated有实据，founded有依据） || 文化联想：“实事求是”强调从事实和证据出发，这种脚踏实地、有现实依据的状态很适合用 grounded 来形容，可以说 **a grounded approach — “'Seek truth from facts' encourages a grounded approach to judgment and policy.”**

quiz.question: outmoded ________
quiz.explanation: 过时的，过时的做法。The company abandoned its outmoded practice. 公司放弃了过时的做法。 | out->超出，mode->模式/时尚，outmoded->超出时尚=过时的（cf. mode流行，modern现代，obsolete过时，antiquated陈旧） || 文化联想：中文说“还抱着老黄历不放”，就是在批评观念已经过时；这种不再适合当下时代的东西可以用 outmoded 来形容，可以说 **an outmoded idea — “Clinging to an old almanac as if nothing had changed is a good image of an outmoded idea.”**

quiz.question: unguarded ______
quiz.explanation: 不谨慎的，不谨慎的评论。His unguarded remark caused controversy. 他不谨慎的评论引起了争议。 | un->否定，guarded->警惕的，unguarded->失去防守的=不谨慎的（cf. guarded谨慎，circumspect谨慎，incautious不谨慎，imprudent轻率） || 文化联想：“酒后吐真言”常说人在放松警惕时不经意说出心里话，这种没有防备、未经斟酌的状态很适合 unguarded，可以说 **an unguarded moment — “A person may reveal a private opinion during an unguarded moment after relaxing his usual caution.”**

quiz.question: ________ deed
quiz.explanation: 契约，财产契约。The lawyer reviewed the property deed. 律师审查了财产契约。 | deed->行为/文书（古英语dæd->所做的事），deed->法律文件/行为（cf. do做，indeed确实=在行动中，misdemeanor轻罪） || 文化联想：中国传统房契、地契就是 deed 最自然的联想之一：它们是正式证明房屋或土地权属的契约文书，deed 可指这种法律契据，可以说 **a property deed — “An old Chinese land contract is a type of property deed recording ownership or transfer.”**

quiz.question: reed ___
quiz.explanation: 芦苇，芦苇床。Birds nested in the reed bed by the river. 鸟儿在河边的芦苇床筑巢。 | reed->芦苇（古英语hreod），reed->芦苇（cf. reed instrument簧管乐器，reedy细长的声音，papyrus纸莎草=古代的reed） || 文化联想：白洋淀大片芦苇荡是 reed 最鲜明的中国景象之一；reed 就是生长在浅水湿地、茎秆细长的芦苇，可以说 **a reed marsh — “Baiyangdian is famous for its broad reed marsh stretching across shallow wetlands.”**

quiz.question: ____ screed
quiz.explanation: 冗长的文章，冗长的文章。The critic wrote a long screed attacking the film. 评论家写了一篇攻击这部电影的冗长的文章。 | screed->长条/碎片（古英语screade->碎片），screed->冗长的口头或书面声明（cf. shred碎片，tirade长篇抨击，harangue长篇演说） || 文化联想：古代“讨伐檄文”若写得洋洋洒洒、充满抨击，可以和 screed 联想到一起；screed 常指冗长、激烈而带批判性的文章或长篇抱怨，可以说 **an angry screed — “A furious denunciation of an official or policy can turn into an angry screed.”**

quiz.question: engaged ______
quiz.explanation: 订婚的，订婚的情侣。The engaged couple planned their wedding. 订婚的情侣计划他们的婚礼。 | en->使，gage->抵押（法语），engaged->用抵押约定的=订婚/全力投入的（cf. engage投入/订婚，disengage脱离，engagement约定/订婚） || 文化联想：传统婚俗里“定亲、下聘”以后，男女双方就进入 engaged 的状态；engaged 在这里就是已经订婚、尚未正式结婚，可以说 **an engaged couple — “After the betrothal gifts are exchanged, the pair may be regarded as an engaged couple.”**

quiz.question: full-fledged ______
quiz.explanation: 完全成熟的，完全成熟的成员。She became a full-fledged member of the organization. 她成为该组织的完全成熟的成员。 | fledge->长出羽毛（古英语飞翔），full-fledged->羽翼丰满的=完全成熟的（cf. fledgling雏鸟/新手，unfledged未成熟，hedge-hop低空飞行） || 文化联想：中文“羽翼丰满”几乎对应 full-fledged 的字面意象：从尚未成熟发展到羽毛长全、能够独立担当，正是 full-fledged（完全成熟、完备的），可以说 **a full-fledged organization — “Once its wings are fully grown, an organization can become a full-fledged organization capable of acting independently.”**

quiz.question: jagged ____
quiz.explanation: 锯齿状的，锯齿状的边缘。The broken glass had a dangerous jagged edge. 破碎的玻璃有危险的锯齿状的边缘。 | jag->尖齿（来源不明），jagged->有许多尖齿的=锯齿状的（cf. jag尖角，serrated锯齿状，notched有缺口，craggy多岩的） || 文化联想：云南石林那些尖锐、参差不齐的岩峰可以用 jagged 来形容；jagged 强调边缘或轮廓像锯齿一样凹凸尖锐，可以说 **jagged stone peaks — “The Stone Forest in Yunnan is filled with jagged stone peaks rising in sharp irregular shapes.”**

quiz.question: ragged _______
quiz.explanation: 破烂的，破烂的衣服。The homeless man wore ragged clothes. 无家可归的人穿着破烂的衣服。 | rag->破布（古挪威rögg->粗毛），ragged->像破布一样残破的（cf. rag破布，ragamuffin流浪者，rags to riches从穷到富） || 文化联想：“衣衫褴褛”最适合联想到 ragged：衣服破旧、边缘撕裂、参差不整，这正是 ragged（破烂的、不整齐的）的核心意思，可以说 **ragged clothes — “A beggar in an old novel may be described as wearing ragged clothes patched and torn at the edges.”**

quiz.question: dogged _____________
quiz.explanation: 顽强的，顽强的决心。Her dogged determination helped her succeed. 她顽强的决心帮助她成功。 | dog->狗（古英语docga），dogged->像狗一样咬住不放的=顽强的（cf. tenacious顽强，persistent坚持，bulldog斗牛犬=执着，dog-eared折角的） || 文化联想：愚公移山明知山高路远仍坚持不辍的劲头可以用 dogged 来形容，那种咬定目标、再难也不放弃的顽强正是 dogged（顽强坚持的）的本义，可以说 **dogged determination — “The Foolish Old Man shows dogged determination by continuing to move the mountains despite the impossible scale of the task.”**

quiz.question: deranged ______
quiz.explanation: 精神错乱的，精神错乱的杀手。The police searched for the deranged killer. 警方搜寻精神错乱的杀手。 | de->去除，range->排列，deranged->排列打乱=精神错乱的（cf. arrange排列，derangement错乱，disorder混乱，unhinged精神失常） || 文化联想：《儒林外史》里范进中举后喜极发疯、言行失常的桥段可以用 deranged 来形容；deranged 指心智失常、精神混乱到行为异常，可以说 **deranged behavior — “After hearing that he had passed the examination, Fan Jin behaved in a deranged manner and temporarily lost control of himself.”**

quiz.question: estranged ______
quiz.explanation: 疏远的，疏远的夫妇。The estranged couple filed for divorce. 疏远的夫妇申请离婚。 | estrange->使疏远（拉丁extraneare->使成陌生），estranged->变得疏远的（cf. strange陌生，stranger陌生人，estrange使疏远，alienate疏远） || 文化联想：“老死不相往来”描述原本有关系的人后来彻底疏远，很适合 estranged；estranged 强调由亲近变得陌生、隔膜甚至断绝往来，可以说 **estranged relatives — “Family members who stop speaking for years can become estranged relatives.”**

quiz.question: detached _____
quiz.explanation: 独立的，独立的房子。They bought a detached house with a garden. 他们买了一座带花园的独立的房子。 | de->去除，tach->连接（法语attacher->连接），detached->从连接中分离的=独立的（cf. attach连接，attachment依恋，detachment超然/分离） || 文化联想：佛道文化里“看破红尘”常表现为对世俗得失保持距离，这种不卷入情绪、显得超然疏离的状态可以用 detached 来形容，可以说 **a detached attitude — “A monk who has 'seen through the red dust' may adopt a detached attitude toward worldly gain and loss.”**

quiz.question: drenched _______
quiz.explanation: 湿透的，湿透的衣服。Her drenched clothes needed to be changed. 她湿透的衣服需要更换。 | drenchen->使沉入（古英语），drenched->被彻底浸湿的（cf. drench使湿透，soak浸泡，saturate饱和，soaking dripping wet湿透） || 文化联想：中文“淋成落汤鸡”就是 drenched 最形象的联想：从头到脚被雨水彻底浸湿，正是 drenched（湿透的）的本义，可以说 **drenched to the skin — “Caught in a summer downpour without an umbrella, a traveler can become drenched to the skin.”**

quiz.question: wretched ____
quiz.explanation: 悲惨的，悲惨的生活。The poor family lived a wretched life. 贫困的家庭过着悲惨的生活。 | wretch->可怜的人（古英语wrecca->流亡者），wretched->像流亡者一样悲惨的（cf. wretch可怜虫，miserable悲惨，wretched excess悲惨过度） || 文化联想：杜甫《茅屋为秋风所破歌》中屋漏、床湿、长夜难眠的困苦生活可以用 wretched 来形容；wretched 强调悲惨、困顿、令人心酸，可以说 **a wretched life — “Du Fu's poem about his wind-damaged thatched cottage evokes a wretched life of cold, rain, and hardship.”**

quiz.question: shed _____
quiz.explanation: 流下，流下眼泪。She would shed tears at the sad movie. 她会在悲伤的电影中流下眼泪。 | sceadan->分离（古英语），shed->让液体流落=流下（cf. bloodshed流血，shed skin蜕皮，watershed分水岭，woodshed柴棚） || 文化联想：“男儿有泪不轻弹”里的“弹泪、流泪”就是 shed tears；shed 在这个意义上指让眼泪、血、叶子等从原处落下或脱落，可以说 **shed tears — “At a funeral, even a stoic person may shed tears for someone deeply loved.”**

quiz.question: accomplished ________
quiz.explanation: 有造诣的，有造诣的音乐家。The accomplished musician performed at Carnegie Hall. 有造诣的音乐家在卡内基音乐厅演出。 | ac->朝向，complet->完成（拉丁complere），accomplished->达到完整成就的=有造诣的（cf. complete完成，accomplish实现，unaccomplished未完成） || 文化联想：“琴棋书画样样精通”描述一个人在多种技艺上都很有造诣，这种成熟娴熟、成就很高的状态可以用 accomplished 来形容，可以说 **an accomplished artist — “A master of calligraphy, poetry, and painting may be described as an accomplished artist.”**

quiz.question: distinguished ______
quiz.explanation: 杰出的，杰出的职业生涯。He retired after a distinguished career in medicine. 他在杰出的职业生涯后退休了。 | dis->分开，stinct->刺/标记（拉丁stinguere），distinguished->被特别标记出来的=杰出的（cf. distinct清楚，instinct本能，extinct灭绝） || 文化联想：“德高望重、名满天下”的学者或名医可以用 distinguished 来形容；distinguished 强调因成就、身份或声望而显得杰出、受人敬重，可以说 **a distinguished scholar — “A scholar respected nationwide for major achievements can be called a distinguished scholar.”**

quiz.question: ______ watershed
quiz.explanation: 分水岭，政策分水岭。The new law marked a policy watershed. 新法律标志着政策分水岭。 | water->水，shed->分流，watershed->水流分界处=转折点（cf. shed流下，water shed分水，turning point转折点，milestone里程碑） || 文化联想：1978年改革开放常被视为中国现代发展进程中的重要 watershed；watershed 就是使前后阶段出现明显分界的关键转折点，可以说 **a watershed moment — “The reform and opening-up policy marked a watershed moment in modern Chinese history.”**

quiz.question: full-bodied ____
quiz.explanation: 醇厚的，醇厚的葡萄酒。The sommelier recommended a full-bodied wine. 侍酒师推荐了醇厚的葡萄酒。 | full->充满，bodied->有身体，full-bodied->具有丰满酒体的=醇厚的（cf. embodied有形的，body形体，full-flavored风味浓郁，robust强壮） || 文化联想：熟普洱茶入口浓厚、醇滑、饱满，可以用 full-bodied 来形容；full-bodied 强调味道、香气或口感厚实丰富，不是单纯“浓”，可以说 **full-bodied Pu-erh tea — “A well-aged ripe Pu-erh can be full-bodied, with a dense and rounded flavor.”**

quiz.question: disembodied _____
quiz.explanation: 无形的，无形的声音。A mysterious disembodied voice echoed in the hall. 神秘的无形的声音在大厅里回荡。 | dis->去除，embody->具体化，disembodied->去除了身体形态的=无形的（cf. embody体现，incorporeal无形，ethereal飘渺，ghostly鬼魂般） || 文化联想：《聊斋》式故事里空屋中只闻说话声却看不见任何人，那种仿佛声音脱离身体独自存在的感觉可以用 disembodied 来形容，可以说 **a disembodied voice — “In a ghost story, a disembodied voice may echo through an empty room with no speaker in sight.”**

quiz.question: studied ___________
quiz.explanation: 故意装出的，故意装出的漠不关心。His studied nonchalance didn't fool anyone. 他故意装出的漠不关心没有骗过任何人。 | studied->经过研究的=刻意的，studied->经过深思熟虑装出来的=故意的（cf. deliberate刻意，calculated精心计算的，affected做作的） || 文化联想：京剧演员的一颦一笑、一步一停都经过训练和设计，这种并非随意自然、而是刻意安排出来的姿态可以用 studied 来形容，可以说 **studied grace — “Every gesture of a trained Peking-opera performer can have a studied grace shaped by years of practice.”**

quiz.question: unqualified _______
quiz.explanation: 完全的，完全的成功。The performance was an unqualified success. 演出是完全的成功。 | un->否定，qualified->有限定条件的，unqualified->没有任何限定条件的=完全的/无资格的（cf. qualified有条件的，unreserved无保留的，outright彻底的） || 文化联想：中文“举双手赞成”若表示毫无保留、没有任何附加条件的赞同，就很接近 unqualified approval；unqualified 在这里表示“完全的、无保留的”，可以说 **unqualified support — “'Raising both hands in favor' expresses unqualified support with no reservation or condition attached.”**

quiz.question: verified _______
quiz.explanation: 经过验证的，经过验证的账户。Her social media verified account had a blue checkmark. 她的社交媒体经过验证的账户有蓝色标记。 | ver->真（拉丁verus），verified->被证明为真的（cf. verify核实，veracity真实性，verdict裁决，aver断言） || 文化联想：微博蓝V最容易帮助记忆 verified：经过平台核实身份的账号可以说 **a verified account — “A blue V on Weibo marks a verified account whose identity has been checked by the platform.”**

quiz.question: unjustified _____
quiz.explanation: 不合理的，不合理的声明。The lawsuit was based on an unjustified claim. 这起诉讼基于不合理的声明。 | un->否定，just->正当（拉丁justus），unjustified->没有正当理由的（cf. justify证明正当，justice正义，adjust调整） || 文化联想：岳飞故事中“莫须有”常被用来指没有充分证据的罪名，可以说 **an unjustified accusation — “The charge remembered as ‘莫须有’ is often cited as an unjustified accusation made without solid evidence.”**

quiz.question: pied _______
quiz.explanation: 斑驳的，斑驳的鹡鸰。The pied wagtail is a common British bird. 斑驳的鹡鸰是常见的英国鸟类。 | pied->杂色的（来自magpie=喜鹊的黑白色），pied->有两种颜色斑块的（cf. pie馅饼=多种材料混合，piebald花斑马，Pied Piper花衣魔笛手） || 文化联想：大熊猫黑白两色块状分布的毛色很适合联想到 pied，可以说 **pied coloring — “The giant panda is instantly recognizable for its pied black-and-white coloring.”**

quiz.question: serried _____
quiz.explanation: 密集的，密集的队列。The soldiers stood in serried ranks. 士兵们站成密集的队列。 | serr->锁紧（拉丁serrare->锁），serried->紧密排列的（cf. series系列，serial连续的，insert插入=放入之间） || 文化联想：秦始皇兵马俑一个挨一个排成严整军阵的景象很适合联想到 serried，可以说 **serried ranks — “The Terracotta Warriors stand in serried ranks, row after row like an army frozen in time.”**

quiz.question: packed _______
quiz.explanation: 拥挤的，拥挤的体育场。The packed stadium roared with excitement. 拥挤的体育场充满兴奋的欢呼。 | pack->打包（古挪威pakki），packed->塞满的=拥挤的（cf. pack包裹，package包装，compact紧凑，impact冲击=打包进去） || 文化联想：春运时列车和候车大厅常常挤得满满当当，可以说 **a packed train — “During the Spring Festival travel rush, a packed train can be filled with passengers heading home for reunion.”**

quiz.question: henpecked _______
quiz.explanation: 怕老婆的，怕老婆的丈夫。The henpecked husband never made decisions alone. 怕老婆的丈夫从不独自做决定。 | hen->母鸡，pecked->啄，henpecked->被母鸡啄的=被老婆管的（cf. hen母鸡，peck啄，cf. under the thumb在拇指下=受控制） || 文化联想：四川方言里开玩笑说“耙耳朵”常指怕老婆、被妻子管得严的丈夫，可以说 **a henpecked husband — “In Sichuan slang, a ‘pa er duo’ jokingly refers to a henpecked husband who is bossed around by his wife.”**

quiz.question: wicked ____
quiz.explanation: 邪恶的，邪恶的行为。The villain committed a wicked deed. 恶棍犯下了邪恶的行为。 | wicca->巫师（古英语），wicked->像巫师一样邪恶的（cf. witch女巫，Wicca现代巫术，cf. wicked witch邪恶女巫） || 文化联想：传统故事里那些害人不眨眼、作恶多端的人物很适合用 wicked 来形容，可以说 **a wicked deed — “In old Chinese tales, a cruel villain who harms innocent people is condemned for every wicked deed he commits.”**

quiz.question: landlocked _______
quiz.explanation: 内陆的，内陆的国家。Switzerland is a landlocked country with no coastline. 瑞士是没有海岸线的内陆的国家。 | land->陆地，locked->锁住，landlocked->被陆地锁住的=内陆的（cf. lock锁，deadlock僵局，hemmed in被围困） || 文化联想：新疆深处亚洲大陆腹地、完全不临海，很适合帮助记忆 landlocked，可以说 **a landlocked region — “Xinjiang is a vast landlocked region in northwestern China, far from any ocean.”**

quiz.question: marked ___________
quiz.explanation: 显著的，显著的改进。There was a marked improvement in his grades. 他的成绩有显著的改进。 | mark->标记，marked->被明确标记出来的=显著的（cf. remarkable值得注意，marker标记，hallmark特征，benchmark基准） || 文化联想：深圳几十年间从边境小镇成长为国际化大城市，这种肉眼可见的巨大变化可以说 **a marked transformation — “Shenzhen underwent a marked transformation from a small border town into a global metropolis.”**

quiz.question: garbled _______
quiz.explanation: 混乱的，混乱的信息。The garbled message was impossible to understand. 混乱的信息无法理解。 | garble->筛选/曲解（阿拉伯语gharbala->筛），garbled->被混乱曲解的（cf. garbage垃圾=筛选后的废料，cf. garble original message歪曲原意） || 文化联想：“以讹传讹”最适合帮助记忆 garbled：消息一层层转述后会变得面目全非，可以说 **a garbled account — “The Chinese idiom 以讹传讹 describes how repeated retelling can turn a story into a garbled account of what actually happened.”**

quiz.question: unbridled _______
quiz.explanation: 不受约束的，不受约束的激情。His unbridled passion for music was evident. 他对音乐不受约束的激情是显而易见的。 | un->否定，bridle->马笼头，unbridled->没有马笼头约束的=放纵的（cf. bridle缰绳，rein控制，unrestrained不受约束） || 文化联想：“脱缰野马”就是没有缰绳约束、越跑越失控的形象，很适合联想到 unbridled，可以说 **unbridled energy — “The image of a runaway horse in 脱缰野马 vividly conveys unbridled energy that can no longer be restrained.”**

quiz.question: brindled ____
quiz.explanation: 有斑纹的，有斑纹的皮毛。The dog had a distinctive brindled coat. 这只狗有独特的有斑纹的皮毛。 | brindled->有黑褐色条纹（来自brand->烙印），brindled->有深色条纹的（cf. brand烙印，brindle虎斑，tabby猫斑纹） || 文化联想：中华田园犬中有些毛色带黑褐交错的虎斑纹，很适合联想到 brindled，可以说 **a brindled coat — “A Chinese village dog may have a brindled coat streaked with dark brown and black.”**

quiz.question: disheveled ____
quiz.explanation: 凌乱的，凌乱的头发。She woke up with disheveled hair. 她醒来时头发凌乱的头发。 | dis->散开，chevel->头发（法语，拉丁capillus），disheveled->头发散开的=凌乱的（cf. capillary毛细管=像发丝，dishevel使蓬乱） || 文化联想：“蓬头垢面”就是头发散乱、仪表狼狈的样子，可以说 **a disheveled appearance — “The idiom 蓬头垢面 describes a disheveled appearance, with messy hair and an unwashed face.”**

quiz.question: muffled _____
quiz.explanation: 低沉的，低沉的声音。A muffled sound came from behind the door. 门后传来低沉的声音。 | muffle->包裹（古法语mofle->厚手套），muffled->被包裹住而变低沉的（cf. muffle消音，muffler消音器/围巾，smother闷住） || 文化联想：除夕夜隔着厚厚的院门听外面的爆竹声，声音会闷闷地传进来，可以说 **muffled firecrackers — “On Lunar New Year’s Eve, firecrackers heard through thick courtyard doors can sound muffled and distant.”**

quiz.question: unspoiled ______
quiz.explanation: 未受破坏的，未受破坏的自然。The island had beautiful unspoiled nature. 该岛有美丽的未受破坏的自然。 | un->否定，spoil->破坏（拉丁spolium->战利品），unspoiled->未被破坏的（cf. spoil破坏/溺爱，despoil掠夺，spoliation掠夺） || 文化联想：陶渊明《桃花源记》描写了一个远离战乱、仿佛未被外界破坏的理想世界，可以说 **an unspoiled paradise — “Tao Yuanming’s Peach Blossom Spring imagines an unspoiled paradise untouched by the turmoil outside.”**

quiz.question: unprincipled _____
quiz.explanation: 无原则的，无原则的恶棍。The unprincipled rogue would do anything for money. 无原则的恶棍会为钱做任何事。 | un->否定，principal->主要的/原则（拉丁princeps->第一），unprincipled->没有原则的（cf. principle原则，principal主要，prince王子） || 文化联想：“见利忘义”就是为了利益连原则和道义都可以丢掉，很适合联想到 unprincipled，可以说 **an unprincipled person — “The idiom 见利忘义 condemns an unprincipled person who abandons righteousness for profit.”**

quiz.question: dappled ________
quiz.explanation: 斑驳的，斑驳的阳光。Dappled sunlight filtered through the trees. 斑驳的阳光透过树木。 | dapple->斑点（古挪威depill->点），dappled->有明暗斑点的（cf. dapple gray苹果灰马，mottled有斑点的，speckled有斑点的） || 文化联想：竹林里阳光透过竹叶洒下明暗交错的小片光影，很适合联想到 dappled，可以说 **dappled sunlight — “In a bamboo grove, dappled sunlight falls through the leaves and creates shifting patches of light and shadow.”**

quiz.question: gnarled ____
quiz.explanation: 扭曲的，扭曲的树。The ancient gnarled tree stood in the park. 古老的扭曲的树矗立在公园里。 | gnarled->有节疤（来自knot->节），gnarled->因年老而扭曲节疤累累的（cf. knot节，gnarl树瘤，gnarly困难的/扭曲的） || 文化联想：黄山古松被风雪塑造成盘曲多节的枝干，很适合联想到 gnarled，可以说 **a gnarled pine — “A gnarled pine clinging to a Huangshan cliff looks twisted and knotted by centuries of wind and weather.”**

quiz.question: settled _____
quiz.explanation: 固定的，固定的习惯。Reading before bed became a settled habit. 睡前阅读成为固定的习惯。 | settle->定居（古英语setlan），settled->已经安定固定的（cf. settlement定居点，unsettled不稳定，settle down安定） || 文化联想：很多老人每天清晨去公园打太极，久而久之会形成雷打不动的固定习惯，可以说 **a settled routine — “For many older Chinese, morning tai chi in the park becomes a settled routine repeated year after year.”**

quiz.question: inflamed ______
quiz.explanation: 发炎的，发炎的组织。The doctor treated the inflamed tissue. 医生治疗了发炎的组织。 | in->使，flame->火焰（拉丁flamma），inflamed->被火点燃的=发炎的（cf. inflammation发炎，flamboyant炫耀的，flammable易燃，flamingo火烈鸟） || 文化联想：中国人常说“上火”时会提到嗓子红肿疼痛，这可以帮助联想到 inflamed，但两者并非医学上的同义词，可以说 **an inflamed throat — “What people colloquially call ‘上火’ may include symptoms such as an inflamed throat, although the terms are not medically equivalent.”**

quiz.question: mistimed ______
quiz.explanation: 不合时宜的，不合时宜的评论。His mistimed remark embarrassed everyone. 他不合时宜的评论让每个人都很尴尬。 | mis->错误，timed->定时，mistimed->时机选择错误的（cf. timely及时，untimely过早，ill-timed不合时宜） || 文化联想：祭祖或追悼这样的庄重场合突然开玩笑，会显得时机完全不对，可以说 **a mistimed joke — “Cracking a joke during a solemn ancestral rite would be a badly mistimed attempt at humor.”**

quiz.question: well-groomed __________
quiz.explanation: 仪表整洁的，仪表整洁的外表。The executive maintained a well-groomed appearance. 这位高管保持着仪表整洁的外表。 | groom->打扮（古挪威gromr->男孩/侍者），well-groomed->被精心打扮的=仪表整洁的（cf. bridegroom新郎=婚礼侍者，grooming梳洗） || 文化联想：“衣冠楚楚”形容一个人衣着整齐、仪表收拾得体，很适合联想到 well-groomed，可以说 **a well-groomed appearance — “The idiom 衣冠楚楚 evokes a well-groomed appearance, with clothing and grooming neat and polished.”**

quiz.question: ____ informed
quiz.explanation: 消息灵通的，消息灵通的。She was well informed about current events. 她对时事消息灵通的。 | inform->告知（拉丁informare->给予形式），well-informed->被充分告知的=消息灵通的（cf. information信息，reform改革，uniform制服） || 文化联想：“秀才不出门，便知天下事”可以帮助记忆 informed：即使不远行，也能掌握外界消息，可以说 **stay informed — “The saying 秀才不出门，便知天下事 praises someone who can stay informed about the wider world without traveling far.”**

quiz.question: unenlightened ____
quiz.explanation: 愚昧的，愚昧的观点。His unenlightened view was outdated. 他愚昧的观点过时了。 | un->否定，enlighten->启蒙（en+light），unenlightened->未受启蒙的=愚昧的（cf. enlightenment启蒙，illuminate照亮，the Enlightenment启蒙运动） || 文化联想：“女子无才便是德”今天常被视为落后于时代的旧观念，很适合联想到 unenlightened，可以说 **an unenlightened belief — “The old saying ‘女子无才便是德’ is often cited today as an unenlightened belief about women’s education.”**

quiz.question: wizened ____
quiz.explanation: 干瘪的，干瘪的脸。The old woman had a wizened face. 老妇人有一张干瘪的脸。 | wizened->干缩（古英语wisnian->干缩），wizened->因年老而干瘪萎缩的（cf. wizen干缩，shrivel萎缩，withered枯萎，shrunken收缩） || 文化联想：传统人物画里饱经风霜的老人常被画得脸颊干瘪、皱纹深刻，可以说 **a wizened face — “An elderly farmer in a traditional ink painting may be given a wizened face, deeply lined by age and sun.”**

quiz.question: feigned _______
quiz.explanation: 假装的，假装的疾病。His feigned illness didn't fool the doctor. 他假装的疾病没有骗过医生。 | feindre->假装（古法语，拉丁fingere->塑造），feigned->被虚构伪装的（cf. fiction虚构，feint假动作，figment虚构物，effigy肖像） || 文化联想：孙膑故事中通过装疯来迷惑敌人的桥段很适合联想到 feigned，可以说 **feigned madness — “In the story of Sun Bin, he survives danger by adopting feigned madness to deceive his enemies.”**

quiz.question: unfeigned _______
quiz.explanation: 真诚的，真诚的喜悦。She expressed unfeigned delight at the news. 她对这个消息表达了真诚的喜悦。 | un->否定，feigned->假装的，unfeigned->非伪装的=真诚的（cf. genuine真诚，sincere真诚，heartfelt由衷的） || 文化联想：春节久别重逢时那种藏不住、发自内心的高兴很适合联想到 unfeigned，可以说 **unfeigned joy — “A Spring Festival reunion can bring unfeigned joy when relatives meet again after a long separation.”**

quiz.question: resigned __________
quiz.explanation: 顺从的，顺从的接受。He showed resigned acceptance of his fate. 他表现出对命运的顺从的接受。 | re->回，sign->标志，resigned->把签名收回=辞职/顺从接受（cf. resign辞职，signature签名，design设计，consign托付） || 文化联想：“听天由命”带有不再挣扎、无奈接受结果的意味，很适合联想到 resigned，可以说 **resigned acceptance — “The phrase 听天由命 can express resigned acceptance when someone stops struggling and leaves the outcome to fate.”**

quiz.question: ingrained _____
quiz.explanation: 根深蒂固的，根深蒂固的习惯。Smoking was an ingrained habit he couldn't break. 吸烟是他无法打破的根深蒂固的习惯。 | in->进入，grain->纹理/谷粒，ingrained->深入纹理的=根深蒂固的（cf. grain纹理，engrave雕刻=深入，deep-seated根深蒂固） || 文化联想：“根深蒂固”本身就是深入根部、难以拔除的形象，很适合联想到 ingrained，可以说 **an ingrained belief — “The idiom 根深蒂固 is a natural image for an ingrained belief that has taken deep root and is difficult to change.”**

quiz.question: constrained _____
quiz.explanation: 勉强的，勉强的微笑。She gave a constrained smile at the bad joke. 她对这个糟糕的笑话露出勉强的微笑。 | con->共同，strain->拉紧（拉丁stringere），constrained->被紧紧绑住的=勉强的（cf. restrain约束，strict严格，constrict收缩，strain张力） || 文化联想：“强颜欢笑”就是心里并不高兴却硬挤出笑容，可以说 **a constrained smile — “The phrase 强颜欢笑 describes a constrained smile forced onto the face despite unhappiness.”**

quiz.question: sustained ______
quiz.explanation: 持续的，持续的努力。Success requires sustained effort over time. 成功需要长期持续的努力。 | sus->在下，tain->持（拉丁tenere），sustained->被持续支撑的（cf. sustain维持，maintain保持，retain保留，obtain获得） || 文化联想：“水滴石穿”强调只有长时间不断重复，微小力量才能产生巨大结果，可以说 **sustained effort — “The idiom 水滴石穿 shows how sustained effort, like dripping water, can eventually wear through stone.”**

quiz.question: ____ defined
quiz.explanation: 明确的，明确定义的。The project had well defined objectives. 该项目有明确定义的目标。 | de->设定，fine->边界（拉丁finis），defined->设定了边界=被定义的（cf. define定义，definite明确，finite有限，infinite无限） || 文化联想：“泾渭分明”用两水分界清楚来形容界限明确，很适合联想到 defined，可以说 **clearly defined boundaries — “The idiom 泾渭分明 evokes clearly defined boundaries, like two bodies of water whose colors remain visibly distinct.”**

quiz.question: ___ tined ____
quiz.explanation: 叉齿的，两叉齿的叉子。The salad was served with a two tined fork. 沙拉配有两叉齿的叉子。 | tine->叉齿（古英语tind->尖，古挪威tindr->山峰），tined->有齿的（cf. prong叉齿，tine叉的齿，pitchfork干草叉） || 文化联想：传统竹耙一根根细长的齿排列成扇形，很适合帮助记忆 tined，可以说 **a many-tined bamboo rake — “A traditional Chinese bamboo rake is a many-tined tool, with long narrow prongs spreading out like a fan.”**

quiz.question: impassioned ____
quiz.explanation: 激昂的，激昂的恳求。The lawyer made an impassioned plea for mercy. 律师发表了激昂的恳求请求宽恕。 | im->使，passion->激情（拉丁pati->受苦），impassioned->充满激情的（cf. passionate热情，compassion同情，dispassionate冷静） || 文化联想：《满江红》传统上被归于岳飞名下，其中激烈昂扬的忠愤之情很适合联想到 impassioned，可以说 **an impassioned poem — “‘Man Jiang Hong,’ traditionally attributed to Yue Fei, is an impassioned poem of loyalty and resolve.”**

quiz.question: unimpassioned ________
quiz.explanation: 冷静的，冷静的分析。The scientist provided an unimpassioned analysis of the data. 科学家提供了数据的冷静的分析。 | un->否定，impassioned->充满激情的，unimpassioned->不带激情的=冷静的（cf. dispassionate冷静，detached超然，objective客观） || 文化联想：中国传统史学强调“秉笔直书”，理想中的史官应尽量不被个人情绪左右，可以说 **an unimpassioned account — “The ideal of 秉笔直书 asks a historian to give an unimpassioned account rather than let personal emotion distort the record.”**

quiz.question: seasoned _______
quiz.explanation: 经验丰富的，经验丰富的老手。The seasoned veteran knew how to handle pressure. 经验丰富的老手知道如何应对压力。 | season->季节/调味（拉丁satio->播种），seasoned->经历过多个季节的=经验丰富的（cf. season季节，seasoning调料，well-seasoned经验丰富） || 文化联想：景德镇烧了几十年瓷器、凭经验就能判断火候的老师傅最适合联想到 seasoned，可以说 **a seasoned craftsman — “A master who has fired porcelain in Jingdezhen for decades is a seasoned craftsman who can judge a kiln by experience.”**

quiz.question: biped ____
quiz.explanation: 两足动物的，两足动物的步态。Humans walk with a distinctive biped gait. 人类以独特的两足动物的步态行走。 | bi->两，ped->脚（拉丁pes），biped->有两只脚的（cf. quadruped四足，centipede百足虫，pedal踏板，pedestrian行人） || 文化联想：周口店北京人遗址最适合帮助记忆 biped：直立人的重要特征就是两足行走，可以说 **a biped hominin — “The Zhoukoudian fossils represent a biped hominin that walked upright on two legs.”**

quiz.question: damped ___________
quiz.explanation: 阻尼的，阻尼的振荡。The engineer designed a damped oscillation system. 工程师设计了阻尼的振荡系统。 | damp->潮湿/减弱（古挪威dampi->蒸汽），damped->被减弱的=阻尼的（cf. damp潮湿，dampen减弱，dampener减震器） || 文化联想：寺庙铜钟敲响后振动会越来越弱、钟声逐渐消失，很适合联想到 damped，可以说 **a damped vibration — “After a bronze temple bell is struck, its motion becomes a damped vibration as the ringing gradually fades.”**

quiz.question: untapped _________
quiz.explanation: 未开发的，未开发的潜力。The region has vast untapped potential. 该地区有巨大的未开发的潜力。 | un->否定，tap->开龙头/利用，untapped->龙头未开的=未被利用的（cf. tap水龙头，tap into利用，exploit开发，harness利用） || 文化联想：中国地方志和家谱中仍有大量材料尚未被充分整理利用，很适合联想到 untapped，可以说 **an untapped resource — “Thousands of local gazetteers and genealogies can remain an untapped resource for historical research.”**

quiz.question: ____-______ quadruped
quiz.explanation: 四足动物，四条腿的四足动物。Dogs are four-legged quadruped mammals. 狗是四条腿的四足动物哺乳动物。 | quadru->四（拉丁），ped->脚，quadruped->有四只脚的（cf. biped两足，centipede百足，tripod三脚架，quadrant四分之一） || 文化联想：十二生肖里的牛、马、羊、狗和猪平时都依靠四条腿行走，可以说 **a quadruped — “The ox, horse, goat, dog, and pig of the Chinese zodiac are all quadrupeds that normally move on four legs.”**

quiz.question: vinegared _____
quiz.explanation: 醋味的，醋味的味道。The salad had a vinegared taste. 沙拉有醋味的味道。 | vin->葡萄酒（法语，拉丁vinum），egre->酸（法语aigre），vinegar->酸葡萄酒=醋（cf. wine葡萄酒，eager渴望=酸得流口水，vineyard葡萄园） || 文化联想：山西老陈醋浇在面食上会形成非常鲜明的酸醋味，很适合联想到 vinegared，可以说 **a vinegared taste — “A bowl of Shanxi noodles finished with mature vinegar has a distinctly vinegared taste.”**

quiz.question: lowbred ______
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的，粗俗的家伙。The lowbred fellow lacked manners. 粗俗的家伙缺乏礼貌。 | low->低，bred->培育，lowbred->在低等环境中培育的=粗俗的（cf. well-bred有教养，thoroughbred纯种，inbred近亲繁殖/根深蒂固） || 文化联想：旧式武侠小说里没教养、言语粗鄙的市井恶徒可以帮助记忆 lowbred，可以说 **a lowbred character — “In an old martial-arts tale, a rude bully with no manners may be portrayed as a lowbred character.”**

quiz.question: sacred ___
quiz.explanation: 神圣的，神圣的誓言。The monks took a sacred vow of silence. 僧侣们立下了神圣的誓言保持沉默。 | sacr->神圣（拉丁sacer），sacred->被奉献给神的=神圣的（cf. sacrifice牺牲，sacrilege亵渎，consecrate奉献，desecrate亵渎） || 文化联想：泰山在中国古代国家祭祀中具有极高的神圣地位，很适合联想到 sacred，可以说 **a sacred site — “Mount Tai was treated as a sacred site where emperors performed major state rituals.”**

quiz.question: kindred _______
quiz.explanation: 志同道合的，志同道合的灵魂。They were kindred spirits who shared the same values. 他们是志同道合的灵魂，有着相同的价值观。 | kin->亲属（古英语cynn->家族），kindred->同族/相似的（cf. kin亲属，kind种类/善良，kindergarten幼儿园，kindle点燃） || 文化联想：伯牙子期“高山流水遇知音”的故事最适合联想到 kindred，可以说 **kindred spirits — “The story of Yu Boya and Zhong Ziqi celebrates two kindred spirits who understand each other through music.”**

quiz.question: checkered ____
quiz.explanation: 有污点的，有污点的过去。The politician had a checkered past. 这位政客有有污点的过去。 | checker->棋盘格（来自chess国际象棋），checkered->像棋盘格黑白交错=起伏不定有污点的（cf. chess象棋，exchequer国库，check棋格/支票） || 文化联想：苏轼仕途几经升迁、贬谪和外放，经历复杂起伏，很适合联想到 checkered，可以说 **a checkered career — “Su Shi had a checkered official career, moving between high office, demotion, and exile.”**

quiz.question: mannered _____
quiz.explanation: 矫揉造作的，矫揉造作的风格。The writer's mannered style was criticized. 这位作家矫揉造作的风格受到批评。 | manner->方式（拉丁manus->手），mannered->过分注重方式的=矫揉造作的（cf. manners礼貌，mannerism独特怪癖，unmannerly失礼） || 文化联想：“拿腔拿调”就是故意摆出一种不自然的腔调和姿态，很适合联想到 mannered，可以说 **a mannered way of speaking — “The phrase 拿腔拿调 describes a mannered way of speaking that sounds deliberately affected.”**

quiz.question: even-tempered ______
quiz.explanation: 性情平和的，性情平和的领导者。The even-tempered leader remained calm in crises. 性情平和的领导者在危机中保持冷静。 | even->平均，temper->脾气（拉丁temperare->调和），even-tempered->脾气均衡的=性情平和的（cf. temperament气质，temperature温度，temper脾气） || 文化联想：“温和敦厚”常用来形容性情平和、不轻易发怒的人，很适合联想到 even-tempered，可以说 **an even-tempered person — “Someone praised as 温和敦厚 is even-tempered, steady, and slow to anger.”**

quiz.question: ____ flustered
quiz.explanation: 慌乱的，感到慌乱。The unexpected question made her feel flustered. 意外的问题让她感到慌乱。 | fluster->使慌乱（古挪威flaustr->匆忙），flustered->被弄得慌乱的（cf. fluster慌乱，flurry忙乱，flutter扑腾，bluster虚张声势） || 文化联想：“手忙脚乱”就是突发状况一来便慌了神、不知先做什么，可以说 **feel flustered — “The idiom 手忙脚乱 describes exactly how people act when they feel flustered and lose their composure.”**

quiz.question: shattered _____
quiz.explanation: 破碎的，破碎的玻璃。Shattered glass covered the floor. 破碎的玻璃覆盖了地板。 | shatter->碎裂（中古英语schateren），shattered->粉碎的/精疲力竭的（cf. shatter粉碎，shattered筋疲力尽，scatter散落，splatter溅散） || 文化联想：“破镜重圆”的故事以破碎的镜子作为分离与重聚的象征，很适合联想到 shattered，可以说 **a shattered mirror — “The image behind 破镜重圆 begins with a shattered mirror whose separated halves are eventually reunited.”**

quiz.question: acquired _____
quiz.explanation: 后天养成的，后天养成的品味。Caviar is an acquired taste. 鱼子酱是后天养成的品味。 | ac->朝向，quire->寻求（拉丁quaerere），acquired->通过努力获得的（cf. acquire获得，require需要，inquiry调查，inquisitive好奇） || 文化联想：臭豆腐常常是第一次闻着抗拒、吃几次后反而喜欢的味道，很适合联想到 acquired，可以说 **an acquired taste — “Stinky tofu can be an acquired taste: off-putting at first, but beloved after repeated exposure.”**

quiz.question: labored _________
quiz.explanation: 费力的，费力的呼吸。The patient had labored breathing. 患者有费力的呼吸。 | labor->劳动（拉丁），labored->费了很大力气的（cf. labor劳动，elaborate精心制作，laboratory实验室=劳动的地方，collaborate合作） || 文化联想：爬泰山长长的石阶后气喘吁吁、每一口气都很费力，可以帮助记忆 labored，可以说 **labored breathing — “After climbing Mount Tai’s long stone stairway, an untrained visitor may reach the top with labored breathing.”**

quiz.question: enamored __
quiz.explanation: 迷恋的，迷恋。She was enamored of the handsome stranger. 她迷恋那个英俊的陌生人。 | en->使，amor->爱（拉丁），enamored->被爱所俘虏的=迷恋的（cf. amorous多情，amiable和蔼，amateur爱好者，amour恋情） || 文化联想：《牡丹亭》中杜丽娘梦中邂逅柳梦梅后深深动情，很适合联想到 enamored，可以说 **enamored of someone — “In The Peony Pavilion, Du Liniang becomes enamored of the young scholar she meets in a dream.”**

quiz.question: _____ restored
quiz.explanation: 修复的，完全修复的。The antique car was fully restored. 古董车被完全修复的。 | re->再次，store->储存（拉丁instaurare->重建），restored->重新建立的=修复的（cf. restore修复，store储存，storage仓储，instore在店内） || 文化联想：故宫古建筑经过文物保护工作重新恢复整洁完整的面貌，很适合联想到 restored，可以说 **a restored historic building — “A carefully restored hall in the Forbidden City preserves the appearance of imperial architecture after conservation work.”**

quiz.question: untutored ___
quiz.explanation: 未受训练的，未受训练的耳朵。To the untutored ear, the music sounded similar. 对未受训练的耳朵来说，音乐听起来相似。 | un->否定，tutor->导师（拉丁tutus->保护），untutored->未受指导的=未受训练的（cf. tutor家教，tutorial辅导，intuition直觉） || 文化联想：“无师自通”强调没有正式老师却自己学会本领，很适合联想到 untutored，可以说 **an untutored talent — “The phrase 无师自通 describes someone whose skill seems remarkable despite being largely untutored and self-taught.”**

quiz.question: marred __________
quiz.explanation: 损坏的，损坏的声誉。The scandal marred reputation of the company. 丑闻损坏的声誉了公司的。 | mar->损坏（古英语merran->阻碍），marred->被损坏的（cf. mar损坏，blemish污点，tarnish失去光泽，sully玷污） || 文化联想：“白璧微瑕”用洁白玉璧上的一点瑕疵形容整体很好却被小缺点破坏，可以说 **perfection marred by a flaw — “The idiom 白璧微瑕 imagines a fine piece of white jade whose perfection is marred by a tiny blemish.”**

quiz.question: inured __ ____
quiz.explanation: 习惯于，习惯于痛苦。The boxer was inured to pain from years of training. 拳击手经过多年训练习惯于痛苦。 | in->使，ure->使用/工作（古法语œuvrer->工作），inured->通过反复使用而习惯的（cf. manure肥料=手工劳作，inure习惯，endure忍耐） || 文化联想：“吃苦耐劳”常形容一个人长期经受辛苦后已经很能扛苦，很适合联想到 inured，可以说 **inured to hardship — “A person praised as 吃苦耐劳 may be inured to hardship after years of demanding work.”**

quiz.question: measured ________
quiz.explanation: 慎重的，慎重的回应。The diplomat gave a measured response. 外交官给出了慎重的回应。 | measure->测量（拉丁mensura），measured->经过仔细测量权衡的=慎重的（cf. measure测量，commensurate相称，immeasurable无法衡量） || 文化联想：“三思而后行”强调先权衡再行动，很适合联想到 measured，可以说 **a measured response — “The maxim 三思而后行 encourages a measured response rather than an impulsive reaction.”**

quiz.question: assured _______
quiz.explanation: 确定的，确定的胜利。The team's assured victory seemed certain. 球队确定的胜利似乎是肯定的。 | as->朝向，sure->确定（拉丁securus），assured->被确认的=确定的（cf. sure确定，secure安全，assurance保证，insurance保险） || 文化联想：“十拿九稳”就是成功几乎确定、没有多少悬念，很适合联想到 assured，可以说 **an assured outcome — “The idiom 十拿九稳 describes an outcome so assured that success seems almost certain.”**

quiz.question: improvised ______
quiz.explanation: 即兴的，即兴的演讲。The mayor gave an impressive improvised speech. 市长发表了令人印象深刻的即兴的演讲。 | im->否定，provis->预见（拉丁providere），improvised->未事先准备的=即兴的（cf. provide提供，provision供应，improvise即兴） || 文化联想：相声里的“现挂”就是根据现场情况临时编出来的包袱，很适合联想到 improvised，可以说 **an improvised joke — “In xiangsheng, 现挂 is an improvised joke created on the spot from something happening in the room.”**

quiz.question: ______ composed
quiz.explanation: 镇定的，保持镇定。She managed to remain composed during the interview. 她在面试期间设法保持镇定。 | com->共同，pose->放置（拉丁ponere），composed->把自己放置好=镇定的（cf. compose作曲，composure镇定，decompose分解） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”赞美大事当前仍能镇定自若，很适合联想到 composed，可以说 **remain composed — “The phrase 泰山崩于前而色不变 praises someone who can remain composed even in the face of a shocking crisis.”**

quiz.question: __ disposed
quiz.explanation: 有意向的，有此意向。If you are so disposed, please join us. 如果你有此意向，请加入我们。 | dis->分，pose->放置，disposed->倾向于某方向放置=有意向的（cf. dispose处置，disposition倾向，predisposed预先倾向，indisposed不舒服） || 文化联想：“乐善好施”形容一个人天性愿意帮助别人、慷慨施予，很适合联想到 disposed，可以说 **disposed to help — “A person praised as 乐善好施 is naturally disposed to help others and give generously.”**

quiz.question: depressed ______
quiz.explanation: 萧条的，萧条的市场。The depressed market showed no signs of recovery. 萧条的市场没有复苏的迹象。 | de->向下，press->压（拉丁premere），depressed->被向下压的=萧条的（cf. suppress镇压，impress给印象，express表达，oppress压迫） || 文化联想：旧时荒年里集市冷清、买卖稀少的景象很适合帮助记忆 depressed，可以说 **a depressed market — “An old county gazetteer describing empty shops and scarce trade in a famine year would be describing a depressed market.”**

quiz.question: repressed ______
quiz.explanation: 压抑的，压抑的记忆。The therapist helped unlock repressed memory. 治疗师帮助解锁压抑的记忆。 | re->向后，press->压，repressed->被向后压制的=压抑的（cf. repress压制，suppress镇压，oppress压迫，depress使沮丧） || 文化联想：“忍”文化里常有把委屈和愤怒压在心里不说出来的形象，可以帮助联想到 repressed，可以说 **repressed feelings — “Someone who keeps anger buried for years may carry repressed feelings that are never openly expressed.”**

quiz.question: ______ impressed
quiz.explanation: 印象深刻的，深深印象深刻。I was deeply impressed by her presentation. 我对她的演讲深深印象深刻。 | im->进入，press->压，impressed->被压入印记=印象深刻的（cf. impression印象，impress给印象，express表达，compress压缩） || 文化联想：“叹为观止”就是看到精彩事物后佩服到觉得再没有什么可以超过它，很适合联想到 impressed，可以说 **deeply impressed — “The idiom 叹为观止 describes being so deeply impressed by a performance or sight that one feels nothing could surpass it.”**

quiz.question: possessed __ ____
quiz.explanation: 被控制的，被恐惧控制。He was possessed by fear and couldn't move. 他被恐惧控制，无法移动。 | pos->放置，sess->坐（拉丁），possessed->被某物占据坐上=被控制的（cf. possess拥有，obsess困扰，assess评估，session会议） || 文化联想：中国志怪故事里常有鬼魂附在人身上、控制其言行的情节，很适合联想到 possessed，可以说 **possessed by a spirit — “In old Chinese ghost stories, a person acting as if a ghost had taken control might be described as possessed by a spirit.”**

quiz.question: star-crossed ______
quiz.explanation: 命运多舛的，命运多舛的恋人。Romeo and Juliet were star-crossed lovers. 罗密欧和朱丽叶是命运多舛的恋人。 | star->星，crossed->交叉/阻碍，star-crossed->被星象阻碍的=命运多舛（莎士比亚创造词，cf. cross阻碍，ill-fated命运多舛） || 文化联想：梁山伯与祝英台被家庭与命运阻隔的爱情最适合联想到 star-crossed，可以说 **star-crossed lovers — “Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai are classic star-crossed lovers whose relationship is thwarted by family expectations and fate.”**

quiz.question: sophisticated ________
quiz.explanation: 复杂的，复杂的分析。The researcher provided a sophisticated analysis. 研究人员提供了复杂的分析。 | sophist->诡辩家（希腊sophos->智慧），sophisticated->被诡辩复杂化的=复杂世故的（cf. philosophy哲学=爱智慧，naive单纯=反义） || 文化联想：苏州园林用借景、框景、曲径等手法层层组织空间，设计十分精巧复杂，很适合联想到 sophisticated，可以说 **a sophisticated design — “The borrowed scenery, framed views, and winding paths of a Suzhou garden form a sophisticated design that reveals itself gradually.”**

quiz.question: dilapidated _____
quiz.explanation: 破旧的，破旧的房子。The dilapidated house needed extensive repairs. 破旧的房子需要大量维修。 | di->分散，lapid->石头（拉丁lapis），dilapidated->石头散落的=破败的（cf. lapis lazuli青金石，lapidary宝石的，lapidation石刑） || 文化联想：“断壁残垣”就是墙倒屋塌、年久失修的破败景象，很适合联想到 dilapidated，可以说 **a dilapidated building — “The phrase 断壁残垣 evokes a dilapidated building reduced to broken walls and crumbling ruins.”**

quiz.question: unmitigated ________
quiz.explanation: 完全的，完全的灾难。The project was an unmitigated disaster. 该项目是完全的灾难。 | un->否定，mitig->软化（拉丁mitis->温和），unmitigated->未被软化的=完全的（cf. mitigate减轻，mild温和，emollient润肤） || 文化联想：“一败涂地”形容失败得彻彻底底、几乎没有任何可挽回之处，很适合联想到 unmitigated，可以说 **an unmitigated disaster — “The idiom 一败涂地 evokes an unmitigated disaster with virtually no redeeming success.”**

quiz.question: striated ______
quiz.explanation: 有条纹的，有条纹的肌肉。Striated muscle tissue contracts voluntarily. 有条纹的肌肉组织自主收缩。 | stria->条纹（拉丁），striated->有条纹的（cf. striate有条纹，stripe条纹，streak条痕，stria地质条纹） || 文化联想：五花肉一层瘦肉一层肥肉形成清楚的条带纹理，很适合联想到 striated，可以说 **striated layers — “A slice of Chinese pork belly shows striated layers of lean meat and fat running in alternating bands.”**

quiz.question: satiated ________
quiz.explanation: 满足的，满足的食欲。The large meal satiated appetite. 大餐满足的食欲。 | sat->够了（拉丁satis->足够），satiated->被满足的（cf. satisfy满足，saturate饱和，satiate使满足，insatiable贪得无厌） || 文化联想：春节团圆饭吃到“酒足饭饱”、一点也不饿了，很适合联想到 satiated，可以说 **fully satiated — “After a Lunar New Year banquet, guests who are 酒足饭饱 are fully satiated, with no desire to eat more.”**

quiz.question: ___ uninitiated
quiz.explanation: 外行的，外行人。The technical jargon confused the uninitiated. 专业术语让外行人感到困惑。 | un->否定，initiate->入门（拉丁initiare->开始），uninitiated->未入门的=外行的（cf. initiate开始，initial初始，initiative主动权） || 文化联想：“外行看热闹，内行看门道”最适合帮助记忆 uninitiated：外行只能看到表面热闹，可以说 **the uninitiated — “The saying 外行看热闹，内行看门道 captures how the uninitiated see only the spectacle while experts notice the technique.”**

quiz.question: unsubstantiated _____
quiz.explanation: 未经证实的，未经证实的声明。The unsubstantiated claim was dismissed. 未经证实的声明被驳回。 | un->否定，sub->在下，stant->站立，unsubstantiated->没有实质支撑的=未证实的（cf. substantial实质，substance物质，instantiate实例化） || 文化联想：“查无实据”就是找不到证据支持某种说法，很适合联想到 unsubstantiated，可以说 **an unsubstantiated rumor — “A claim described as 查无实据 is an unsubstantiated rumor or accusation lacking supporting evidence.”**

quiz.question: belated _______
quiz.explanation: 迟来的，迟来的道歉。He offered a belated apology for his mistake. 他为自己的错误提供了迟来的道歉。 | be->使，late->晚，belated->变得太晚了的=迟来的（cf. late晚，lately近来，delay延迟，tardy迟到） || 文化联想：一桩冤案几十年后才获得纠正，可以让人联想到 belated，可以说 **belated justice — “When a wrongful conviction is finally corrected decades later, people may call it belated justice.”**

quiz.question: deflated ___
quiz.explanation: 受挫的，受挫的自我。His failure left him with a deflated ego. 他的失败让他有受挫的自我。 | de->向下，flat->平坦（拉丁flatus->吹气），deflated->被放了气的=受挫的（cf. inflate充气，deflate放气，inflation通货膨胀，flatulence胀气） || 文化联想：“像泄了气的皮球”形容一个人突然没了精神和信心，正好对应 deflated，可以说 **a deflated ball — “The Chinese expression 像泄了气的皮球 describes someone losing confidence like a deflated ball collapsing after the air escapes.”**

quiz.question: ____ discombobulated
quiz.explanation: 混乱的，感到混乱。The complicated instructions made him feel discombobulated. 复杂的说明让他感到混乱。 | discombobulate->使混乱（19世纪美国俚语，可能来自discompose+bother），discombobulated->被彻底搞糊涂的（cf. flummoxed困惑，bamboozled被耍） || 文化联想：“丈二和尚摸不着头脑”就是完全搞不清状况、被弄得晕头转向，很适合联想到 discombobulated，可以说 **completely discombobulated — “The saying 丈二和尚摸不着头脑 captures the feeling of being completely discombobulated and unable to make sense of what is happening.”**

quiz.question: maculated ____
quiz.explanation: 有斑点的，有斑点的叶子。The disease caused maculated leaf. 疾病导致有斑点的叶子。 | macula->斑点（拉丁），maculated->有斑点的（cf. immaculate无瑕疵的=无斑点，macular黄斑的，maculate有斑点） || 文化联想：受潮的旧书画或古籍上常会出现一块块深色霉斑和污迹，很适合联想到 maculated，可以说 **a maculated manuscript — “An old Chinese manuscript damaged by damp may become a maculated manuscript covered with dark stains and blotches.”**

quiz.question: calculated ____
quiz.explanation: 精心策划的，精心策划的举动。It was a calculated move to gain advantage. 这是精心策划的举动以获得优势。 | calcul->小石子（拉丁calculus->小石子，古代用于计数），calculated->经过仔细计算的（cf. calculate计算，calculus微积分，calcium钙=石灰石） || 文化联想：“步步为营”强调每一步都经过盘算、稳住以后再走下一步，很适合联想到 calculated，可以说 **a calculated move — “The strategy of 步步为营 suggests a calculated move made only after each position has been secured.”**

quiz.question: unregulated ______
quiz.explanation: 不受监管的，不受监管的市场。The unregulated market led to chaos. 不受监管的市场导致混乱。 | un->否定，regulate->调节（拉丁regula->规则），unregulated->没有规则调节的（cf. regular定期，regulate调节，ruler统治者/尺子） || 文化联想：“没有规矩，不成方圆”强调缺乏规则就容易陷入混乱，很适合联想到 unregulated，可以说 **an unregulated market — “The saying 没有规矩，不成方圆 helps explain why an unregulated market can easily fall into disorder.”**

quiz.question: animated ____
quiz.explanation: 动画的，动画电影。The children watched an animated film. 孩子们观看了动画电影。 | anima->灵魂/生命（拉丁），animated->赋予生命/动作的（cf. animal动物=有灵魂的，animate赋予生命，magnanimous宽宏大量，unanimous全体一致） || 文化联想：“眉飞色舞”就是讲到兴奋处表情动作都活了起来，很适合联想到 animated，可以说 **an animated conversation — “The idiom 眉飞色舞 describes an animated conversation in which excitement shows clearly on the speaker’s face.”**

quiz.question: _______ underestimated
quiz.explanation: 被低估的，被严重低估。The cost was grossly underestimated. 成本被严重低估。 | under->低于，estimate->估计（拉丁aestimare），underestimated->估计低于实际的（cf. estimate估计，esteem尊重，overestimate高估） || 文化联想：“骄兵必败”提醒人不能轻视对手，很适合联想到 underestimated，可以说 **an underestimated opponent — “The warning 骄兵必败 reflects the danger of an underestimated opponent: dismissing the other side can lead to defeat.”**

quiz.question: opinionated ______
quiz.explanation: 固执己见的，固执己见的立场。He took an opinionated stance on the issue. 他对这个问题采取了固执己见的立场。 | opinion->意见（拉丁opinio），opinionated->过分坚持自己意见的（cf. opinion意见，opine持有意见，pinion翅膀=观点支持） || 文化联想：“固执己见”形容一个人只认自己的看法、不愿听别人意见，很适合联想到 opinionated，可以说 **an opinionated person — “The idiom 固执己见 describes an opinionated person who clings to personal views and refuses to listen to others.”**

quiz.question: bloated ___________
quiz.explanation: 臃肿的，臃肿的官僚机构。The bloated bureaucracy needed reform. 臃肿的官僚机构需要改革。 | bloat->膨胀（古挪威blautr->软湿），bloated->过度膨胀的=臃肿的（cf. bloat膨胀，inflate充气，distended膨胀，obese肥胖） || 文化联想：“机构臃肿”形容部门层级太多、人员冗余，正好可以帮助记忆 bloated，可以说 **a bloated bureaucracy — “The expression 机构臃肿 describes a bloated bureaucracy with too many layers, offices, and redundant posts.”**

quiz.question: celebrated ______
quiz.explanation: 著名的，著名的艺术家。The celebrated artist displayed her work. 著名的艺术家展示了她的作品。 | celeber->著名（拉丁），celebrated->被广泛庆贺而著名的（cf. celebrate庆祝，celebrity名人，celebrity status名人地位） || 文化联想：李白在中国文学史上声名极盛，是最典型的 celebrated 人物之一，可以说 **a celebrated poet — “Li Bai is a celebrated poet whose fame has endured for more than a millennium.”**

quiz.question: serrated _____
quiz.explanation: 锯齿状的，锯齿状的刀。Use a serrated knife to cut the bread. 用锯齿状的刀切面包。 | serra->锯子（拉丁），serrated->像锯一样有齿的（cf. Sierra山脉=锯齿山，serration锯齿，saw锯子） || 文化联想：茶树叶片边缘常有一排细小的锯齿，很适合联想到 serrated，可以说 **a serrated leaf — “A fresh tea leaf often has a finely serrated edge, with tiny saw-like teeth along the margin.”**

quiz.question: saturated ___
quiz.explanation: 饱和的，饱和脂肪。Saturated fat should be limited in diet. 饮食中应限制饱和脂肪。 | satur->足够（拉丁satis），saturated->充分填满的=饱和的（cf. satiate满足，satisfy满足，insatiable贪得无厌，Saturday土星日=充足） || 文化联想：春节装饰常把大面积高纯度红色铺满门窗和街道，很适合联想到 saturated，可以说 **saturated red — “Traditional Lunar New Year decorations often use a saturated red that looks rich and intense.”**

quiz.question: sated ________
quiz.explanation: 满足的，满足的食欲。After the feast, everyone had a sated appetite. 盛宴后，每个人都有满足的食欲。 | satis->足够（拉丁），sated->被充分满足的（cf. satisfy满足，satiate使满足，saturate饱和，insatiable贪得无厌） || 文化联想：“饱汉不知饿汉饥”把已经吃饱的人和挨饿的人作对比，很适合联想到 sated，可以说 **the sated diner — “The proverb 饱汉不知饿汉饥 contrasts the sated diner with the hungry person to warn that comfort can make suffering hard to understand.”**

quiz.question: premeditated ______
quiz.explanation: 预谋的，预谋的谋杀。The crime was premeditated murder. 这起犯罪是预谋的谋杀。 | pre->提前，meditat->思考（拉丁meditari），premeditated->提前思考策划的（cf. meditate冥想，mediation调解，remedy补救） || 文化联想：荆轲刺秦在行动前准备地图、匕首并谋划接近秦王，很适合联想到 premeditated，可以说 **a premeditated attack — “Jing Ke’s attempt on the King of Qin was a premeditated attack prepared in advance with a hidden dagger and a forged map.”**

quiz.question: unpremeditated ___
quiz.explanation: 非预谋的，非预谋的行为。It was an unpremeditated act of passion. 这是激情的非预谋的行为。 | un->否定，premeditated->预谋的，unpremeditated->未经预谋的=非预谋的（cf. spontaneous自发，impulsive冲动，spur-of-the-moment一时冲动） || 文化联想：“脱口而出”就是没经过事先计划、话一下子从嘴里冒出来，很适合联想到 unpremeditated，可以说 **an unpremeditated remark — “A comment that slips out 脱口而出 is an unpremeditated remark, spoken without prior planning.”**

quiz.question: agitated _____
quiz.explanation: 激动的，激动的人群。The agitated crowd demanded answers. 激动的人群要求答案。 | agit->推动（拉丁agitare->驱使），agitated->被激烈推动的=激动的（cf. agitate激动，agitation鼓动，agitator鼓动者，agile敏捷） || 文化联想：“坐立不安”就是焦躁得坐也不是、站也不是，很适合联想到 agitated，可以说 **an agitated state — “The idiom 坐立不安 describes an agitated state in which a person is too anxious to sit or stand comfortably.”**

quiz.question: understated ________
quiz.explanation: 低调的，低调的优雅。The room had understated elegance. 房间有低调的优雅。 | under->低于，stated->表达的，understated->表达低于实际的=低调的（cf. understate低调表达，overstate夸大，understatement保守说法） || 文化联想：宋代水墨画往往不用浓艳装饰，而靠留白和克制营造含蓄之美，很适合联想到 understated，可以说 **understated elegance — “The restraint and empty space of a Song-dynasty ink painting can create understated elegance rather than flashy decoration.”**

quiz.question: graduated ___
quiz.explanation: 累进的，累进税。The country has a graduated tax system. 该国有累进税制度。 | gradu->步骤（拉丁gradus->阶梯），graduated->按阶梯分级的=累进的（cf. grade等级，gradual逐渐，gradient坡度，degrade降级） || 文化联想：“循序渐进”强调按阶段一步一步推进，很适合联想到 graduated，可以说 **a graduated approach — “The principle 循序渐进 favors a graduated approach, advancing step by step rather than changing everything at once.”**

quiz.question: superannuated _________
quiz.explanation: 过时的，过时的设备。The factory used superannuated equipment. 工厂使用过时的设备。 | super->超过，annu->年（拉丁annus），superannuated->超过年龄限制的=过时的（cf. annual年度，anniversary周年，annuity年金，biannual每两年） || 文化联想：中文里把老朽过气、早该退出舞台的人戏称为“老古董”，很适合联想到 superannuated，可以说 **a superannuated official — “An old bureaucrat who has long outlived his usefulness might be mocked as a superannuated official, an ‘老古董’ still occupying the post.”**

quiz.question: antiquated ______
quiz.explanation: 陈旧的，陈旧的系统。The antiquated system needed updating. 陈旧的系统需要更新。 | antiqu->古（拉丁antiquus），antiquated->变得过于古老的=陈旧的（cf. antique古董，antiquity古代，antiquarian古物研究者） || 文化联想：“还抱着老黄历不放”就是拿早已过时的老办法应付新情况，很适合联想到 antiquated，可以说 **an antiquated idea — “The expression 还抱着老黄历不放 mocks someone who clings to an antiquated idea long after circumstances have changed.”**

quiz.question: infatuated ___
quiz.explanation: 迷恋的，迷恋的粉丝。The infatuated fan followed the celebrity everywhere. 迷恋的粉丝到处跟着这位名人。 | in->使，fatuus->愚蠢（拉丁），infatuated->被愚弄而着迷的=迷恋的（cf. fatuous愚蠢，fatuity愚蠢，fanatic狂热者=fanum神庙） || 文化联想：“情人眼里出西施”最适合帮助记忆 infatuated：迷恋一个人时会觉得对方格外美好，可以说 **infatuated with someone — “The saying 情人眼里出西施 captures how someone infatuated with a lover sees beauty that others may not see.”**

quiz.question: cultivated _____
quiz.explanation: 有修养的，有修养的品味。He had cultivated taste in art. 他在艺术方面有有修养的品味。 | cultiv->耕作（拉丁colere->耕），cultivated->经过精心耕耘培养的（cf. culture文化，cultivate培养，agriculture农业，cult崇拜） || 文化联想：传统“君子”理想强调读书修身、举止有礼，最适合联想到 cultivated，可以说 **a cultivated gentleman — “The traditional ideal of the 君子 combines learning, self-discipline, and refined manners, making him a cultivated gentleman in the cultural sense.”**

quiz.question: ______ indebted
quiz.explanation: 负债的，深深负债。The company was deeply indebted. 公司深深负债。 | in->进入，debt->债务（拉丁debitum），indebted->欠债的/感激的（cf. debt债务，debit借方，due应付的，owe欠） || 文化联想：“滴水之恩，当涌泉相报”强调受人一点恩惠也要铭记回报，很适合联想到 indebted，可以说 **deeply indebted to someone — “The saying 滴水之恩，当涌泉相报 expresses feeling deeply indebted to someone even for a small kindness.”**

quiz.question: distracted _______
quiz.explanation: 分心的，分心的驾驶。Distracted driving causes many accidents. 分心的驾驶导致许多事故。 | dis->分开，tract->拉（拉丁trahere），distracted->被拉向不同方向=分心的（cf. distract分心，attract吸引，extract提取，tractor拖拉机） || 文化联想：“心不在焉”就是人虽然坐在这里，注意力却跑到别处去了，很适合联想到 distracted，可以说 **a distracted mind — “The idiom 心不在焉 describes a distracted mind whose attention is somewhere else even while the body is present.”**

quiz.question: dejected ____
quiz.explanation: 沮丧的，沮丧的表情。He had a dejected look after losing the game. 输掉比赛后，他有沮丧的表情。 | de->向下，ject->投掷（拉丁jacere），dejected->被向下投掷=沮丧的（cf. reject拒绝，project投影，inject注射，eject驱逐） || 文化联想：“垂头丧气”把失败后低着头、没有精神的样子直接画了出来，很适合联想到 dejected，可以说 **look dejected — “The idiom 垂头丧气 literally pictures someone hanging the head in discouragement and perfectly describes how a dejected person looks.”**

quiz.question: ______ collected
quiz.explanation: 镇定的，保持镇定。Despite the chaos, she managed to remain collected. 尽管一片混乱，她还是设法保持镇定。 | col->共同，lect->选择（拉丁legere），collected->把自己整合集中=镇定的（cf. collect收集，select选择，recollect回忆，intellect智力） || 文化联想：“镇定自若”就是别人都慌了，自己仍然神色如常、头脑清楚，很适合联想到 collected，可以说 **calm and collected — “The idiom 镇定自若 describes someone who remains calm and collected even when everyone else is panicking.”**

quiz.question: other-directed ___________
quiz.explanation: 他人导向的，他人导向的人格。People with an other-directed personality are influenced by external social pressures. 拥有他人导向的人格的人受外部社会压力的影响。 | other->他人，directed->导向，other-directed->以他人为参照的（cf. inner-directed内在导向，self-directed自我导向，Riesman社会学概念） || 文化联想：传统社会里“看别人脸色行事、随大流”的处世方式很适合联想到 other-directed，可以说 **an other-directed outlook — “In a tightly knit community, an other-directed person may shape his choices around what relatives and neighbors think.”**

quiz.question: undirected _____
quiz.explanation: 无向的，无向图。An undirected graph has edges with no direction. 无向图的边没有方向。 | un->否定，directed->有方向的，undirected->没有方向的（cf. directed有向，graph图，direct直接，directory目录） || 文化联想：中文常说“像无头苍蝇一样乱撞”，正好体现没有明确方向的状态，可以说 **undirected movement — “Running around like a headless fly is a vivid image of undirected movement.”**

quiz.question: blighted _____
quiz.explanation: 破灭的，破灭的希望。The economic crisis led to blighted hopes for many families. 经济危机导致许多家庭破灭的希望。 | blight->枯萎病（来源不明），blighted->被枯萎病摧毁的=破灭的（cf. blight枯萎，withered枯萎，blighted area衰败地区） || 文化联想：蝗灾过境后庄稼枯死、农民一年收成化为乌有的景象很适合联想到 blighted，可以说 **blighted crops — “After the locusts passed, the fields were filled with blighted crops and the harvest was ruined.”**

quiz.question: ____ discomfited
quiz.explanation: 尴尬的，看起来尴尬。She would look discomfited when caught in a lie. 当谎言被揭穿时，她会看起来尴尬。 | dis->否定，comfort->舒适（拉丁confortare->增强），discomfited->被打败/尴尬的（cf. comfort安慰，discomfort不适，discomfit使尴尬） || 文化联想：一个人当众被拆穿谎言后面红耳赤、下不来台的窘态可以用 discomfited 来形容，可以说 **look discomfited — “He looked discomfited when everyone realized that his story did not add up.”**

quiz.question: merited ______
quiz.explanation: 应得的，应得的赞扬。His hard work received merited praise from the manager. 他的辛勤工作得到了经理应得的赞扬。 | merit->功绩（拉丁meritum），merited->值得的=应得的（cf. meritorious有功，demerit过失，meritocracy精英制度） || 文化联想：“十年寒窗，一朝金榜题名”所得到的荣誉是凭努力挣来的，可以说 **merited recognition — “After years of study, the scholar’s success in the imperial examination brought him merited recognition.”**

quiz.question: unrequited ____
quiz.explanation: 单恋的，单恋的爱。He suffered from unrequited love for years. 他遭受了多年的单恋的爱。 | un->否定，re->回，quit->偿还（拉丁quietus->了结），unrequited->未被偿还的（cf. requite回报，quit放弃，acquit无罪开释，quite完全） || 文化联想：“落花有意，流水无情”最适合帮助记忆 unrequited，可以说 **unrequited love — “The saying ‘the falling flower is willing, but the flowing water is heartless’ captures the pain of unrequited love.”**

quiz.question: stilted _____
quiz.explanation: 生硬的，生硬的散文。The novelist's stilted prose was difficult to read. 小说家生硬的散文难以阅读。 | stilt->高跷，stilted->像踩高跷一样不自然的=生硬的（cf. stilt高跷，stilted behavior做作举止，unnatural不自然） || 文化联想：初学文言文的人硬套古人句式，写出来往往僵硬不自然，可以说 **stilted prose — “His attempt to imitate classical Chinese produced stilted prose that sounded forced rather than elegant.”**

quiz.question: warranted ______
quiz.explanation: 有正当理由的，有正当理由的行动。The emergency situation called for warranted action. 紧急情况需要有正当理由的行动。 | warrant->保证/授权（古法语warantir->保护），warranted->有授权保证的（cf. warranty保修，warrant搜查令，guarantee保证） || 文化联想：包公断案讲究证据确凿、依法而断，这种有充分理由支持的决定可以说 **a warranted decision — “With clear evidence before him, the magistrate considered the punishment a warranted decision.”**

quiz.question: unwarranted _____
quiz.explanation: 无根据的，无根据的声明。The lawsuit was based on an unwarranted claim. 诉讼基于无根据的声明。 | un->否定，warranted->有理由的，unwarranted->无正当理由的（cf. warrant授权，warranty保修，unjustified无正当理由） || 文化联想：岳飞故事中“莫须有”后来常被用来指缺乏依据的罪名，可以说 **an unwarranted accusation — “A charge based on ‘莫须有’ is remembered as an unwarranted accusation lacking solid evidence.”**

quiz.question: unscented ______
quiz.explanation: 无香味的，无香味的乳液。She preferred unscented lotion for sensitive skin. 她更喜欢敏感皮肤用的无香味的乳液。 | un->否定，scent->香味（拉丁sentire->感受），unscented->无香味的（cf. scent气味，scentless无味，fragrance香味，odorless无味） || 文化联想：中国传统审美里“淡而不艳”也常体现在不施香粉、没有人工香气的日用品上，可以说 **an unscented product — “For someone who prefers a plain, fragrance-free style, an unscented product can be more appealing than a perfumed one.”**

quiz.question: unprecedented ____
quiz.explanation: 史无前例的，史无前例的举动。The company made an unprecedented move to cut prices. 公司做出了史无前例的举动降低价格。 | un->否定，pre->之前，ced->走（拉丁cedere），unprecedented->从未有过先例的（cf. precede先于，precedent先例，exceed超出） || 文化联想：改革开放初期“摸着石头过河”的探索具有打破旧模式、没有现成先例可循的意味，可以说 **an unprecedented experiment — “China’s early reform and opening-up was an unprecedented experiment that often proceeded by ‘crossing the river by feeling the stones.’”**

quiz.question: demented ____
quiz.explanation: 疯狂的，疯狂的咆哮。His demented rant scared everyone in the room. 他疯狂的咆哮吓坏了房间里的每个人。 | de->去除，ment->心智（拉丁mens），demented->失去心智的=疯狂的（cf. mental心智，mentality心态，dementia痴呆，comment评论=共同心智） || 文化联想：《儒林外史》里范进中举后喜极发疯的失常状态很适合联想到 demented，可以说 **a demented state — “After hearing that he had passed the examination, Fan Jin briefly appeared to be in a demented state.”**

quiz.question: ____ contented
quiz.explanation: 满足的，感到满足。After the meal, everyone would feel contented. 用餐后，每个人都会感到满足。 | content->满足（拉丁contentus->满足的），contented->感到满足的（cf. content内容/满足，discontent不满，contentment满足感） || 文化联想：陶渊明“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”的知足心境可以用 contented 来形容，可以说 **a contented life — “Tao Yuanming’s quiet life among fields and chrysanthemums is often imagined as a contented life.”**

quiz.question: __ acquainted ____
quiz.explanation: 熟悉的，熟悉。I need to be acquainted with the new procedures. 我需要熟悉新程序。 | ac->朝向，quaint->知道（古法语acointier），acquainted->与...相识的（cf. quaint古朴/奇特，acquaint使熟悉，acquaintance熟人） || 文化联想：中国人说“混个脸熟”，就是从陌生到彼此认识、逐渐熟悉，可以说 **be acquainted with someone — “After visiting the same teahouse for months, he became acquainted with many of the regular customers.”**

quiz.question: unwonted ________
quiz.explanation: 不寻常的，不寻常的善意。His unwonted kindness surprised everyone. 他不寻常的善意让每个人都感到惊讶。 | un->否定，wont->习惯（古英语gewunod->习惯），unwonted->不符合习惯的=不寻常的（cf. wont习惯，wonted惯常的，accustomed习惯的） || 文化联想：一个平日严厉寡言的老师突然对学生格外温柔，会显得反常而少见，可以说 **unwonted kindness — “The stern teacher surprised the class with unwonted kindness on the eve of graduation.”**

quiz.question: devoted ___
quiz.explanation: 忠诚的，忠诚的粉丝。She was a devoted fan of the band. 她是乐队的忠诚的粉丝。 | de->完全，vot->誓言（拉丁votum），devoted->完全发誓奉献的=忠诚的（cf. devote奉献，vow誓言，vote投票，devout虔诚） || 文化联想：焦裕禄长期扎根兰考、把大量精力投入当地治理的形象很适合联想到 devoted，可以说 **a devoted public servant — “Jiao Yulu is widely remembered as a devoted public servant who worked tirelessly for the people of Lankao.”**

quiz.question: halfhearted _______
quiz.explanation: 三心二意的，三心二意的尝试。His halfhearted attempt failed predictably. 他三心二意的尝试可预见地失败了。 | half->一半，hearted->心意，halfhearted->只用了一半心意的=三心二意（cf. wholehearted全心全意，lukewarm不冷不热，half-baked不完整） || 文化联想：“做一天和尚撞一天钟”常被用来形容敷衍应付、没有真正投入，可以说 **a halfhearted effort — “Doing a job merely to go through the motions is a halfhearted effort rather than a serious commitment.”**

quiz.question: fainthearted ________
quiz.explanation: 胆怯的，胆怯的方法。The fainthearted approach would not succeed. 胆怯的方法不会成功。 | faint->微弱（法语feint->假装），hearted->心，fainthearted->心气微弱的=胆怯的（cf. faint昏倒，timid胆小，pusillanimous胆小） || 文化联想：中文说“畏首畏尾”，就是遇事怕前怕后、不敢放手去做，可以说 **a fainthearted approach — “A fainthearted approach, always afraid of what may go wrong, rarely achieves anything bold.”**

quiz.question: stouthearted ____
quiz.explanation: 勇敢的，勇敢的英雄。The stouthearted hero rescued the child from the fire. 勇敢的英雄从火中救出了孩子。 | stout->强壮（古法语estout->大胆），hearted->心，stouthearted->心志强壮的=勇敢的（cf. stout粗壮，stalwart坚定，lionhearted勇猛如狮） || 文化联想：关羽“单刀赴会”所表现的临危不惧很适合联想到 stouthearted，可以说 **a stouthearted warrior — “In the story of the single-sword meeting, Guan Yu is portrayed as a stouthearted warrior who faces danger without flinching.”**

quiz.question: deserted ______
quiz.explanation: 荒芜的，荒芜的岛屿。They were stranded on a deserted island. 他们被困在荒芜的岛屿上。 | de->完全，sert->离开（拉丁serere->连接），deserted->被完全遗弃的=荒芜的（cf. desert沙漠/抛弃，dessert甜点，dissertation论文） || 文化联想：春节期间一些大城市商业区突然人少车少、街道空荡荡，可以用 deserted 来形容，可以说 **deserted streets — “During the Spring Festival exodus, some normally crowded city streets can look almost deserted.”**

quiz.question: purported ________
quiz.explanation: 声称的，声称的证据。The purported evidence was never verified. 声称的证据从未得到验证。 | pur->提前，port->携带/显示（拉丁），purported->声称携带某种含义的=声称的（cf. purport声称，import进口，export出口，report报告） || 文化联想：民间常见“祖传秘方”的宣传，但有些只是自称如此、未经证实，可以说 **a purported secret formula — “The vendor advertised it as a purported ancestral secret formula, though no evidence supported the claim.”**

quiz.question: assorted ______
quiz.explanation: 各种各样的，各种各样的零食。The party had assorted snacks for guests. 派对为客人准备了各种各样的零食。 | as->朝向，sort->种类，assorted->按种类分好的=各种各样的（cf. sort分类，assort分类，assortment各种物品，resort度假胜地） || 文化联想：过年攒盒里瓜子、花生、糖果、蜜饯混在一起，正是 assorted 的直观画面，可以说 **assorted New Year treats — “The tray was filled with assorted New Year treats, from sunflower seeds and peanuts to candies and dried fruit.”**

quiz.question: disinterested ______
quiz.explanation: 公正的，公正的建议。The mediator provided disinterested advice. 调解员提供了公正的建议。 | dis->否定，interest->利益，disinterested->不受个人利益影响的=公正的（注意与uninterested=不感兴趣区别，cf. impartial公正） || 文化联想：包公“铁面无私”的形象强调不受私人利益左右，很适合联想到 disinterested，可以说 **a disinterested judgment — “Bao Zheng is traditionally praised for giving a disinterested judgment without favoring relatives or the powerful.”**

quiz.question: tightfisted _____
quiz.explanation: 吝啬的，吝啬的守财奴。The tightfisted miser never spent money. 吝啬的守财奴从不花钱。 | tight->紧，fisted->握拳，tightfisted->拳头握紧不松钱的=吝啬的（cf. tight紧，closefisted吝啬，miserly吝啬，stingy小气） || 文化联想：中文把极端吝啬的人叫“铁公鸡——一毛不拔”，正好对应 tightfisted，可以说 **a tightfisted miser — “Calling someone an ‘iron rooster that will not lose a single feather’ is a vivid Chinese way to describe a tightfisted miser.”**

quiz.question: committed ____
quiz.explanation: 尽心尽力的，尽心尽力的团队。The committed team worked overtime to finish. 尽心尽力的团队加班完成工作。 | com->共同，mit->送（拉丁mittere），committed->把自己送出去=尽心尽力的（cf. commit承诺，committee委员会，submit提交，permit允许） || 文化联想：愚公移山所体现的认准目标、长期投入可以用 committed 来形容，可以说 **a committed effort — “The Foolish Old Man’s determination to keep moving the mountains represents a deeply committed effort.”**

quiz.question: ______ uncommitted
quiz.explanation: 未承诺的，保持未承诺。The voters chose to remain uncommitted. 选民选择保持未承诺。 | un->否定，committed->已承诺的，uncommitted->未承诺的=中立的（cf. commit承诺，commitment承诺，fence-sitting骑墙） || 文化联想：“骑墙观望”就是迟迟不肯站队或作出承诺，可以说 **remain uncommitted — “When both sides asked for his support, he chose to remain uncommitted and wait to see what happened.”**

quiz.question: unspotted ______
quiz.explanation: 清白的，清白的记录。He maintained an unspotted record throughout his career. 他在整个职业生涯中保持了清白的记录。 | un->否定，spotted->有污点的，unspotted->没有污点的=清白的（cf. spot斑点，spotless无污点，blemish污点，unblemished无瑕） || 文化联想：“两袖清风”常用来称赞官员一生没有贪腐污点，可以说 **an unspotted record — “A magistrate remembered for ‘clean sleeves’ was praised for an unspotted record in office.”**

quiz.question: convoluted ____
quiz.explanation: 复杂的，复杂的情节。The movie had a convoluted plot that was hard to follow. 这部电影有复杂的情节难以理解。 | con->共同，volut->滚动（拉丁volvere），convoluted->卷成一团的=复杂的（cf. revolve旋转，evolve进化，involve涉及，devolve下放） || 文化联想：中文说“九曲十八弯”，可以形容一件事绕来绕去、复杂难懂，可以说 **a convoluted explanation — “His explanation took so many twists and turns that it became a convoluted explanation worthy of ‘nine bends and eighteen turns.’”**

quiz.question: muted _____
quiz.explanation: 柔和的，柔和的颜色。The room was decorated in muted color. 房间用柔和的颜色装饰。 | mute->静音（拉丁mutus->沉默），muted->被压低的=柔和的（cf. mute静音，mutism缄默症，mutual相互=共同沉默，permute置换） || 文化联想：中国水墨画常用灰、墨、淡色营造不张扬的视觉效果，可以说 **a muted palette — “The ink-wash painting used a muted palette of soft grays and pale washes rather than bright colors.”**

quiz.question: subdued ____
quiz.explanation: 低沉的，低沉的语气。She spoke in a subdued tone. 她用低沉的语气说话。 | sub->在下，due->引导（拉丁ducere），subdued->被压制在下的=低沉的（cf. subdue征服，reduce减少，deduce推断，induce诱导） || 文化联想：重大丧事之后人们说话轻、情绪低，整个气氛往往压抑克制，可以说 **a subdued atmosphere — “After the funeral, the family gathered in a subdued atmosphere and spoke in quiet voices.”**

quiz.question: depraved ___
quiz.explanation: 堕落的，堕落的行为。The criminal committed a depraved act. 罪犯犯下了堕落的行为。 | de->向下，prav->弯曲（拉丁pravus->歪），depraved->道德弯曲=堕落的（cf. depravity堕落，pravity腐败，cf. moral depravity道德沦丧） || 文化联想：《金瓶梅》常被用来描写欲望、权钱和道德败坏，其中一些人物行为可以用 depraved 来形容，可以说 **depraved behavior — “The novel portrays episodes of depraved behavior driven by greed, lust, and abuse of power.”**

quiz.question: ____ relieved
quiz.explanation: 放心的，感到放心。She would feel relieved when the exam was over. 当考试结束时，她会感到放心。 | re->再次，lev->举起（拉丁levare），relieved->重担被举走的=放心的（cf. relieve减轻，lever杠杆，elevate提升，relevant相关） || 文化联想：高考结束或成绩公布后，中国学生常说“终于一颗心落地了”，这种如释重负可以说 **feel relieved — “When the admission result finally arrived, she felt relieved, as if a weight had been lifted from her heart.”**

quiz.question: contrived ____
quiz.explanation: 牵强的，牵强的情节。The novel's contrived plot lacked authenticity. 小说牵强的情节缺乏真实性。 | con->共同，triv->发现（拉丁tropare->找到），contrived->刻意安排的=牵强的（cf. contrive策划，retrieve找回，troubadour吟游诗人=找到歌曲的人） || 文化联想：一些“狗血剧”为了制造巧合硬凑剧情，会让人觉得很不自然，可以说 **a contrived plot — “The drama relied on a contrived plot in which long-lost relatives kept meeting by coincidence.”**

quiz.question: ______ unmoved
quiz.explanation: 无动于衷的，保持无动于衷。He would remain unmoved by her tears. 他会对她的眼泪保持无动于衷。 | un->否定，moved->被感动的，unmoved->未被感动的=无动于衷的（cf. move感动，moved感动的，stoic禁欲/无动于衷） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”也可以形容面对巨大刺激仍不为所动，可以说 **remain unmoved — “Even when everyone around him panicked, he remained unmoved, as if Mount Tai could collapse before him without changing his expression.”**

quiz.question: undeserved ______
quiz.explanation: 不应得的，不应得的赞扬。The politician received undeserved praise. 政客得到了不应得的赞扬。 | un->否定，deserve->应得（拉丁deservire->充分服务），undeserved->未经充分服务得到的（cf. deserve应得，merit功绩，earn赢得） || 文化联想：靠关系“走后门”得到本不属于自己的荣誉，很适合联想到 undeserved，可以说 **undeserved praise — “If someone receives honors only through connections, the praise may feel undeserved.”**

quiz.question: unreserved _______
quiz.explanation: 无保留的，无保留的支持。The team gave unreserved support to their captain. 球队给予队长无保留的支持。 | un->否定，reserve->保留（拉丁reservare），unreserved->没有保留的=全力的（cf. reserve保留，reservoir水库，reservation预订/保留） || 文化联想：中国人说“掏心掏肺”，强调毫无保留地表达感情和支持，可以说 **unreserved support — “His old friends gave him unreserved support, speaking and helping with complete openness.”**

quiz.question: hallowed ______
quiz.explanation: 神圣的，神圣的土地。The cemetery was hallowed ground. 墓地是神圣的土地。 | hallow->使神圣（古英语halig->圣），hallowed->被奉为神圣的（cf. holy神圣，Halloween万圣节前夕=圣者之夜，hallowed halls神圣殿堂） || 文化联想：烈士陵园被视为庄严、不可亵渎之地，很适合联想到 hallowed，可以说 **hallowed ground — “For many visitors, a martyrs’ cemetery is hallowed ground that should be approached with respect.”**

quiz.question: hackneyed ______
quiz.explanation: 陈腐的，陈腐的短语。The speaker used a hackneyed phrase. 演讲者使用了陈腐的短语。 | Hackney->伦敦地名（出租马车集中地），hackneyed->像出租马车一样被过度使用的=陈腐的（cf. hack出租马车司机/滥用，cliché陈词滥调） || 文化联想：“新瓶装旧酒”常讽刺看似新鲜、其实还是被说烂了的老一套，可以说 **a hackneyed idea — “The proposal sounded new, but critics dismissed it as a hackneyed idea—old wine in a new bottle.”**

quiz.question: specialized ________
quiz.explanation: 专业的，专业的培训。The job requires specialized training. 这份工作需要专业的培训。 | special->特殊（拉丁specialis），specialized->专门化的（cf. special特殊，specialist专家，specialize专门化，species物种） || 文化联想：中文“术业有专攻”强调每个人在特定领域有专门本领，可以说 **specialized expertise — “The saying ‘every profession has its own specialty’ points to the value of specialized expertise.”**

quiz.question: institutionalized ______
quiz.explanation: 制度化的，制度化的种族主义。The country struggled with institutionalized racism. 该国与制度化的种族主义作斗争。 | institute->建立（拉丁instituere），institutionalized->被纳入制度的（cf. institution机构，institute研究所，constitute构成，statute法规） || 文化联想：科举在中国历史上长期成为选拔官员的正式制度，是 institutionalized 的典型例子，可以说 **an institutionalized system — “For centuries, the imperial examination became an institutionalized system for selecting officials.”**

quiz.question: underutilized ______
quiz.explanation: 未充分利用的，未充分利用的资产。The company had underutilized assets. 公司有未充分利用的资产。 | under->低于，utilize->利用（拉丁utilis->有用），underutilized->使用低于应有水平的（cf. utilize利用，utility实用，utensil器具） || 文化联想：“大材小用”指有能力或资源却没有充分发挥价值，很适合联想到 underutilized，可以说 **underutilized talent — “Putting a highly skilled craftsman on trivial errands leaves his talent underutilized.”**

quiz.question: ______ mermaid
quiz.explanation: 美人鱼，小美人鱼。The fairy tale was about a little mermaid. 这个童话讲述了一个小美人鱼。 | mere->湖/海（古英语），maid->少女，mermaid->海中少女=美人鱼（cf. mere湖泊，maiden少女，siren海妖，cf. The Little Mermaid小美人鱼） || 文化联想：中国古代“鲛人泣珠”的传说塑造了半人半鱼的海中异类形象，可以说 **a Chinese mermaid legend — “The tale of the jiaoren, a sea-dwelling being said to weep pearls, resembles a Chinese mermaid legend.”**

quiz.question: ______ raid
quiz.explanation: 突袭，警察突袭。The police raid uncovered illegal weapons. 警察突袭发现了非法武器。 | raid->突击（古英语rad->骑马/道路），raid->骑马突击=突袭（cf. road道路，inroad进攻，cavalcade骑马游行） || 文化联想：《三国演义》中“夜袭”常靠出其不意迅速进攻取胜，可以说 **a surprise raid — “A commander who strikes the enemy camp at night may win through a surprise raid.”**

quiz.question: upbraid ________
quiz.explanation: 责备，严厉责备。The teacher would upbraid severely the misbehaving student. 老师会严厉责备行为不端的学生。 | up->向上，braid->编辫子（扭曲），upbraid->向上扭转=责骂（cf. braid编，tirade长篇斥责，rebuke责备，upbraid vs reprimand区别） || 文化联想：古代家塾里长辈或先生当众严厉训斥犯错子弟，可以用 upbraid 来表达，可以说 **upbraid someone publicly — “The stern elder upbraided the young man publicly for bringing shame on the family.”**

quiz.question: staid _________
quiz.explanation: 稳重的，稳重的性格。He had a staid character that never changed. 他有从不改变的稳重的性格。 | staid->固定（stay的古式过去分词），staid->不喜变化的=稳重保守的（cf. stay停留，stayed固定，steadfast坚定，sedate沉稳） || 文化联想：传统印象中的“老学究”一板一眼、庄重保守，很适合联想到 staid，可以说 **a staid scholar — “The old scholar was staid in dress and manner, rarely changing habits formed decades earlier.”**

quiz.question: rabid ___
quiz.explanation: 狂热的，狂热的粉丝。He was a rabid fan of the sports team. 他是体育队的狂热的粉丝。 | rabies->狂犬病（拉丁rabere->疯狂），rabid->像患了狂犬病一样狂热的（cf. rabies狂犬病，rage愤怒，rave狂热，rabid nationalist狂热民族主义者） || 文化联想：现代中文常说“狂热粉丝”，那种为偶像近乎失去理性的追捧可以用 rabid 来加强语气，可以说 **a rabid fan — “He was such a rabid fan of the singer that he followed every concert and defended her against any criticism.”**

quiz.question: underbid _ _____
quiz.explanation: 出价低于，出价低于对手。The company tried to underbid a rival for the contract. 公司试图在合同上出价低于对手。 | under->低于，bid->出价，underbid->出价低于竞争者（cf. bid出价，forbid禁止，overbid出价过高，abide遵守） || 文化联想：工程招标中企业为了抢项目故意报出比竞争者更低的价格，可以说 **underbid a rival — “To win the construction contract, the company tried to underbid its rival by several million yuan.”**

quiz.question: forbid _____
quiz.explanation: 禁止，禁止进入。The sign would forbid entry to unauthorized personnel. 标志会禁止进入未经授权的人员。 | for->反对（古英语，加强否定），bid->命令，forbid->命令不得=禁止（cf. bid命令，forbid禁止，forbidden禁止的，god-forsaken被遗弃的） || 文化联想：故宫过去许多区域会有“游人止步”之类的禁令，可以说 **forbid entry — “The notice at the palace gate forbade entry to anyone without authorization.”**

quiz.question: morbid _________
quiz.explanation: 病态的，病态的好奇心。She had a morbid curiosity about death. 她对死亡有病态的好奇心。 | morbus->疾病（拉丁），morbid->与疾病/死亡相关的=病态的（cf. morbidity发病率，comorbidity共病，immortal不死，mordant腐蚀性） || 文化联想：民间“聊斋”式鬼怪故事常引发人们对死亡、尸体和阴森事物的猎奇，可以说 **morbid curiosity — “Strange tales of ghosts and graves can awaken a morbid curiosity about death and the supernatural.”**

quiz.question: placid ____
quiz.explanation: 平静的，平静的湖。The placid lake reflected the mountains perfectly. 平静的湖完美地倒映着山脉。 | placid->平静（拉丁placidus->令人愉悦），placid->宁静令人愉悦的（cf. placate平息，placebo安慰剂，complaisant殷勤，Lake Placid普莱西德湖） || 文化联想：杭州西湖无风时“水光潋滟”、湖面平静如镜，可以说 **a placid lake — “On a windless morning, West Lake can appear as a placid lake reflecting pagodas and distant hills.”**

quiz.question: viscid ______
quiz.explanation: 粘稠的，粘稠的液体。The viscid liquid was difficult to pour. 粘稠的液体难以倾倒。 | viscum->槲寄生（拉丁，其浆果粘稠），viscid->像槲寄生浆果一样粘稠的（cf. viscous粘稠，viscosity粘度，viscose人造丝=粘稠的） || 文化联想：熬麦芽糖时糖浆拉丝、黏手、不容易流动的状态很适合联想到 viscid，可以说 **a viscid syrup — “Traditional malt sugar becomes a viscid syrup that stretches into sticky threads.”**

quiz.question: pellucid _____
quiz.explanation: 清澈的，清澈的水。The mountain stream had pellucid water. 山溪有清澈的水。 | per->彻底，lucid->光（拉丁lux），pellucid->彻底透光的=清澈的（cf. lucid清晰，translucent半透明，transparent透明，illuminate照亮） || 文化联想：九寨沟一些海子清澈到能看清水下石块，可以说 **pellucid water — “The lakes of Jiuzhaigou are famous for pellucid water through which stones and fallen branches can be seen clearly.”**

quiz.question: candid _____
quiz.explanation: 自然的，自然的照片。The photographer took candid photo at the wedding. 摄影师在婚礼上拍摄了自然的照片。 | candidus->白色/光明（拉丁），candid->像白色一样纯洁坦诚的（cf. candidate候选人=穿白袍者，candor坦诚，incandescent白炽） || 文化联想：街头摄影抓到老人下棋、孩子玩耍等没有摆拍的瞬间，可以说 **a candid photograph — “The photographer captured a candid photograph of elderly men playing chess in a neighborhood park.”**

quiz.question: sordid ______
quiz.explanation: 肮脏的，肮脏的事件。The scandal revealed a sordid affair. 丑闻揭露了肮脏的事件。 | sordid->肮脏（拉丁sordidus->污秽），sordid->道德上肮脏的（cf. sordor污秽，absurd荒谬，cf. sordid details肮脏细节） || 文化联想：“权钱交易、暗箱操作”这类见不得光的勾当很适合联想到 sordid，可以说 **a sordid deal — “The investigation exposed a sordid deal in which public favors had been exchanged for private money.”**

quiz.question: rigid _____
quiz.explanation: 严格的，严格的规则。The school had rigid rules about uniforms. 学校有关于制服的严格的规则。 | rig->僵硬（拉丁rigere->僵硬），rigid->僵硬不弯的=严格的（cf. rigor严格，rigorous严格，rigor mortis尸僵，frigid寒冷） || 文化联想：旧式私塾“先生怎么说就怎么做”、规矩毫无变通，可以说 **rigid rules — “The old-style school imposed rigid rules that left students little room for individual choice.”**

quiz.question: frigid _______
quiz.explanation: 寒冷的，寒冷的气候。Antarctica has a frigid climate year-round. 南极洲全年都有寒冷的气候。 | frigus->寒冷（拉丁），frigid->极度寒冷的（cf. refrigerator冰箱=re+frigid，Frigidaire冰箱品牌，frigidity冷淡） || 文化联想：漠河冬季严寒、常出现极低温天气，很适合联想到 frigid，可以说 **a frigid winter — “Mohe is known for a frigid winter in which temperatures can remain far below freezing.”**

quiz.question: turgid _____
quiz.explanation: 浮夸的，浮夸的散文。The writer's turgid prose was hard to read. 作家浮夸的散文难以阅读。 | turger->肿胀（拉丁turgere），turgid->肿胀的=浮夸的（cf. turgid river肿胀的河，turgor膨胀压，deturgescence消肿） || 文化联想：中文常说某些官样文章“又臭又长、空话连篇”，可以用 turgid 来形容，可以说 **turgid prose — “The official document was filled with turgid prose, grand phrases, and very little real information.”**

quiz.question: orchid ______
quiz.explanation: 兰花，兰花园。The botanical orchid garden displayed rare species. 植物兰花园展示了稀有物种。 | orchis->睾丸（希腊，兰花球茎的形状），orchid->兰花（cf. orchiectomy睾丸切除，cf. 兰花球茎得名于此古希腊词） || 文化联想：兰花在中国文人传统中常被视为“花中君子”，象征清雅高洁，可以说 **a prized orchid — “In Chinese literati culture, a prized orchid often symbolizes refinement, integrity, and quiet elegance.”**

quiz.question: squalid __________
quiz.explanation: 肮脏的，肮脏的环境。The refugees lived in squalid conditions. 难民生活在肮脏的环境中。 | squalere->肮脏（拉丁，像鳞片一样粗糙），squalid->极度肮脏恶劣的（cf. squalor肮脏，squally狂风，squall风暴） || 文化联想：“脏乱差”是中文里形容恶劣居住环境的常用说法，很适合联想到 squalid，可以说 **squalid conditions — “The old alley had deteriorated into squalid conditions, with rubbish piled up and dirty water running along the ground.”**

quiz.question: stolid __________
quiz.explanation: 木然的，木然的表情。He maintained a stolid expression during the trial. 他在审判期间保持木然的表情。 | stolidus->迟钝（拉丁），stolid->迟钝木讷的=木然的（cf. stoic禁欲的，solid固体，solidity坚固，stolidity木讷） || 文化联想：“喜怒不形于色”有时会让一个人显得木然、难以读懂，可以说 **a stolid expression — “The old official kept a stolid expression, revealing neither pleasure nor anger.”**

quiz.question: humid _______
quiz.explanation: 潮湿的，潮湿的气候。The tropical region has a humid climate. 热带地区有潮湿的气候。 | humor->液体/体液（拉丁umor），humid->充满液体的=潮湿的（cf. humidity湿度，humidifier加湿器，humor体液/幽默，exhume掘出） || 文化联想：江南梅雨季空气湿重、衣服晾几天也不干，可以说 **humid weather — “During the plum-rain season, the humid weather can leave walls damp and clothes difficult to dry.”**

quiz.question: tumid _____
quiz.explanation: 肿胀的，肿胀的河流。Heavy rains caused the tumid river to overflow. 大雨导致肿胀的河流溢出。 | tumor->肿（拉丁tumere->肿），tumid->肿胀的（cf. tumor肿瘤，tumult骚乱，contumacy抗命，tumid river水位暴涨） || 文化联想：黄河汛期水势上涨、河面鼓胀浑浊，可以用 tumid 来形容，可以说 **a tumid river — “After days of heavy rain, the Yellow River became a tumid river swollen with muddy floodwater.”**

quiz.question: _____-______ arachnid
quiz.explanation: 蛛形纲动物，八条腿的蛛形纲动物。Spiders are eight-legged arachnid creatures. 蜘蛛是八条腿的蛛形纲动物生物。 | Arachne->阿拉克涅（希腊神话织布少女，被雅典娜变成蜘蛛），arachnid->蛛形纲动物（cf. arachnophobia恐蜘蛛，Athena雅典娜） || 文化联想：《西游记》里的“蜘蛛精”最容易帮助记忆 arachnid 这一类八足动物，可以说 **an arachnid creature — “The spider spirits in Journey to the West are fantastical versions of an arachnid creature with the familiar spider form.”**

quiz.question: anthropoid ___
quiz.explanation: 类人的，类人猿。Gorillas are anthropoid ape species. 大猩猩是类人猿物种。 | anthropo->人（希腊anthropos），oid->形状，anthropoid->人形的（cf. anthropology人类学，android机器人，humanoid类人，misanthrope厌世者） || 文化联想：中国古人类学和民间“猿人”想象都容易让人联想到 anthropoid，可以说 **an anthropoid ape — “Early descriptions of ape-like human ancestors often emphasized their anthropoid, or humanlike, appearance.”**

quiz.question: asteroid ____
quiz.explanation: 小行星，小行星带。The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter. 小行星带位于火星和木星之间。 | aster->星（希腊），oid->像，asteroid->像星星的小天体（cf. asterisk星号，astronomy天文，disaster灾难=星象不利，aster紫菀） || 文化联想：中国古籍中的“天外飞石”可以作为理解 asteroid 的文化钩子，可以说 **an asteroid fragment — “A ‘stone from the sky’ in an old chronicle might today be investigated as a meteorite or an asteroid fragment.”**

quiz.question: _______ sangfroid
quiz.explanation: 沉着，展现沉着。The pilot would display sangfroid during the emergency. 飞行员会在紧急情况下展现沉着。 | sang->血（法语），froid->冷（法语），sangfroid->冷血=沉着（cf. sang-froid=cold blood法语，cold-blooded冷血，composure镇定） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”最适合联想到 sangfroid，可以说 **remarkable sangfroid — “A general who remains calm even as danger closes in displays remarkable sangfroid.”**

quiz.question: intrepid ________
quiz.explanation: 无畏的，无畏的探险家。The intrepid explorer ventured into unknown territory. 无畏的探险家冒险进入未知领域。 | in->否定，trepid->颤抖（拉丁trepidus），intrepid->不颤抖的=无畏的（cf. trepidation恐惧不安，trepid颤抖，bold大胆，dauntless无畏） || 文化联想：郑和七下西洋、率船队远航未知海域的形象很适合联想到 intrepid，可以说 **an intrepid navigator — “Zheng He is often remembered as an intrepid navigator who led enormous fleets across the Indian Ocean.”**

quiz.question: tepid ________
quiz.explanation: 冷淡的，冷淡的反应。The proposal received a tepid response. 该提案得到了冷淡的反应。 | tepid->温热（拉丁tepidus->微温），tepid->不冷不热=冷淡的（cf. tepid water温水，lukewarm不冷不热，intrepid无畏=不颤抖） || 文化联想：中文说“不冷不热”，既能指温度，也能指态度不够热情，正好对应 tepid，可以说 **a tepid response — “The proposal received only a tepid response: polite nods, but little genuine enthusiasm.”**

quiz.question: insipid ____
quiz.explanation: 乏味的，乏味的汤。The insipid soup lacked flavor. 乏味的汤缺乏味道。 | in->无，sapid->味道（拉丁sapere->品味），insipid->无味道的=乏味的（cf. sapid美味，sapient有智慧的=能品味的，sage智者） || 文化联想：清粥小菜如果一点盐味都没有，中文会说“寡淡无味”，可以说 **an insipid meal — “The plain porridge tasted like an insipid meal with almost no seasoning or flavor.”**

quiz.question: limpid ______
quiz.explanation: 清澈的，清澈的溪流。The limpid stream flowed through the meadow. 清澈的溪流流过草地。 | limpid->清澈（拉丁limpidus->清水），limpid->清澈透明的（cf. lymph淋巴=清水，pellucid清澈，translucent半透明，limpia西班牙语清洁） || 文化联想：桂林漓江常以清澈秀美著称，很适合联想到 limpid，可以说 **a limpid stream — “Near Guilin, a limpid stream can reveal pebbles beneath the water as clearly as if there were no surface at all.”**

quiz.question: arid ______
quiz.explanation: 干旱的，干旱的沙漠。The arid desert received little rainfall. 干旱的沙漠很少降雨。 | aridus->干燥（拉丁），arid->极度干燥的（cf. aridity干旱，arid zone干旱地带，aridness干燥，cf. semi-arid半干旱） || 文化联想：塔克拉玛干沙漠极端缺水、植被稀少，是 arid 的典型中国地理联想，可以说 **an arid landscape — “The Taklamakan presents an arid landscape of sand, sparse vegetation, and very little rainfall.”**

quiz.question: hybrid _______
quiz.explanation: 混合动力的，混合动力的车辆。The hybrid vehicle uses both gas and electricity. 混合动力的车辆同时使用汽油和电力。 | hybris->杂种（希腊，指不同种类的后代），hybrid->两种不同来源的混合体（cf. hybridize杂交，crossbreed杂种，composite复合） || 文化联想：“油电混合”已经是中国新能源汽车市场里很熟悉的概念，可以说 **a hybrid vehicle — “Many Chinese drivers choose a hybrid vehicle that combines an electric motor with a gasoline engine.”**

quiz.question: florid _____
quiz.explanation: 华丽的，华丽的散文。The author's florid prose was overly decorative. 作者华丽的散文过于华丽。 | floridus->开花的（拉丁flos->花），florid->开满花的=华丽的（cf.
