Florida佛罗里达=鲜花之地，floral花卉，flourish繁荣，flower花） || 文化联想：传统宫殿里雕梁画栋、金碧辉煌的装饰有时可用 florid 来形容，可以说 **florid decoration — “The temple hall was covered in florid decoration, with painted beams, gilded details, and elaborate patterns.”**

quiz.question: torrid _______
quiz.explanation: 炽热的，炽热的恋情。They had a torrid romance that summer. 那年夏天他们有炽热的恋情。 | torrere->烤/灼热（拉丁），torrid->炽热灼烧的（cf. torrent激流=灼热融化的，torch火把，torrid zone热带，torrefy烘烤） || 文化联想：重庆盛夏那种炙热难耐的天气可以用 torrid 来形容，可以说 **a torrid summer — “Chongqing is famous for a torrid summer when the heat can feel almost overwhelming.”**

quiz.question: fetid ____
quiz.explanation: 恶臭的，恶臭的气味。A fetid odor came from the garbage. 垃圾发出恶臭的气味。 | foetidus->恶臭（拉丁），fetid->发出恶臭的（cf. fetor恶臭，putrid腐臭，rank臭，fetid breath口臭） || 文化联想：臭豆腐发酵后那股强烈、刺鼻甚至让陌生人退避的气味很适合联想到 fetid，可以说 **a fetid smell — “To an unaccustomed visitor, a batch of strongly fermented tofu may give off a fetid smell.”**

quiz.question: languid _________
quiz.explanation: 慵懒的，慵懒的午后。They spent a languid afternoon by the pool. 他们在泳池边度过了慵懒的午后。 | languere->衰弱（拉丁），languid->精力衰竭的=慵懒的（cf. languish憔悴，languor慵懒，lassitude乏力，languorous慵懒的） || 文化联想：炎热午后茶馆里人靠着竹椅昏昏欲睡、懒洋洋的状态可以用 languid 来形容，可以说 **a languid afternoon — “On a hot summer day, the old teahouse settled into a languid afternoon of slow fans and sleepy conversation.”**

quiz.question: liquid ______
quiz.explanation: 流动的，流动资产。The company had plenty of liquid assets. 公司有充足的流动资产。 | liquidus->流动（拉丁liquere），liquid->流动的（cf. liquor酒，liqueur利口酒，liquefy液化，liquidate清算，prolixity冗长） || 文化联想：旧时钱庄里的现银能随时用于支付或兑换，很适合联想到 liquid，可以说 **liquid assets — “Silver held by a traditional money shop functioned as liquid assets because it could be used or exchanged immediately.”**

quiz.question: fervid ______
quiz.explanation: 热烈的，热烈的辩论。The politicians engaged in fervid debate. 政客们进行了热烈的辩论。 | fervere->沸腾（拉丁），fervid->沸腾般热烈的（cf. fervent热情，fervour热情，ferment发酵，fever发烧） || 文化联想：战国“百家争鸣”中各家针锋相对、热烈辩论的气氛很适合联想到 fervid，可以说 **a fervid debate — “The intellectual clashes of the Hundred Schools of Thought can be imagined as a fervid debate over how society should be governed.”**

quiz.question: perfervid ____
quiz.explanation: 极度热情的，极度热情的热忱。His perfervid zeal for the cause was inspiring. 他对事业的极度热情的热忱令人鼓舞。 | per->彻底，fervid->热烈，perfervid->极度热烈的（cf. fervid热烈，fervent热情，perfervid比fervid程度更强） || 文化联想：民族危亡时慷慨激昂、近乎燃烧般的救国热情可以用 perfervid 来形容，可以说 **perfervid patriotism — “In times of national crisis, speeches sometimes appealed to perfervid patriotism and an intense willingness to sacrifice.”**

quiz.question: piebald ____
quiz.explanation: 花斑的，花斑的小马。The children loved the piebald pony. 孩子们喜欢花斑的小马。 | pie->喜鹊（黑白相间），bald->有色块，piebald->黑白花斑的（cf. pied斑驳，magpie喜鹊，skewbald棕白花斑，bald秃头） || 文化联想：中国水墨画里的花斑马、花猫常用黑白或深浅色块交错表现，很适合联想到 piebald，可以说 **a piebald coat — “The village pony had a piebald coat of large black and white patches.”**

quiz.question: ribald ____
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的，粗俗的笑话。He told a ribald joke that embarrassed everyone. 他讲了一个粗俗的笑话让每个人都很尴尬。 | ribaud->浪荡子（古法语），ribald->说下流笑话的=粗俗的（cf. bawdy下流，lewd淫秽，ribaldry粗俗言行） || 文化联想：传统民间小调里有些作品带荤段子、粗俗笑话，这种放肆诙谐可以用 ribald 来形容，可以说 **ribald humor — “Some old marketplace performances entertained crowds with ribald humor and jokes that respectable scholars would have considered improper.”**

quiz.question: _____ shield
quiz.explanation: 盾牌，防爆盾牌。The soldiers used a blast shield for protection. 士兵们使用防爆盾牌保护。 | shield->盾（古英语sceld），shield->防护盾（cf. windshield挡风玻璃，heat shield隔热罩，yield屈服=放下盾） || 文化联想：“以身为盾”在中国英雄故事中常用来表现替别人挡住危险，可以说 **shield someone from danger — “The guard stepped forward to shield the child from danger when debris began to fall.”**

quiz.question: wield _____
quiz.explanation: 行使，行使权力。The king would wield power over his subjects. 国王会对臣民行使权力。 | wieldan->操控（古英语），wield->操控使用（cf. yield屈服，wield a sword挥剑，unwieldy难以操控，cf. wield influence施加影响） || 文化联想：关羽手持青龙偃月刀的经典形象很适合帮助记忆 wield，可以说 **wield a weapon — “In traditional depictions, Guan Yu wields his Green Dragon Crescent Blade with formidable strength.”**

quiz.question: meld ________
quiz.explanation: 融合，融合在一起。The cultures would meld together over time. 文化会随着时间融合在一起。 | meld->融合（可能来自melt+weld的混合），meld->混合融为一体（cf. merge合并，blend混合，melt融化，weld焊接） || 文化联想：“中西合璧”强调把两种传统融合成一个新整体，很适合联想到 meld，可以说 **meld two traditions — “Shanghai’s old architecture often seems to meld Chinese and Western traditions into a distinctive urban style.”**

quiz.question: weld ____
quiz.explanation: 焊接，焊接接缝。The worker would weld seam on the metal pipe. 工人会焊接金属管上的接缝。 | weldan->融合（古英语），weld->通过热融合连接（cf. weld焊接，weld together连接，wielder操控者，cf. weld vs braze区别） || 文化联想：中国高铁和大型桥梁建设中，钢构件需要牢固焊接，可以说 **weld steel sections — “Workers weld steel sections together while assembling the structure of a modern bridge.”**

quiz.question: fold ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 折叠，折叠衣服。Please fold the clothes after they dry. 衣服干了之后请折叠衣服。 | faldan->折（古英语），fold->折叠（cf. unfold展开，manifold多种，scaffold脚手架，folder文件夹） || 文化联想：中国人说“卷铺盖走人”里的“卷”和“折叠收起”很接近 fold 的动作，可以说 **fold up a quilt — “Before storing the bedding, she folded up the thick quilt and placed it in the cabinet.”**

quiz.question: scaffold ________
quiz.explanation: 脚手架，脚手架平台。Workers stood on the scaffold platform. 工人们站在脚手架平台上。 | scaffold->脚手架（古法语eschafaut，ex+catafalque->临时台子），scaffold->建筑支架/断头台（cf. catafalk灵柩台，scaffolding脚手架） || 文化联想：传统木结构建筑修缮时，工匠会在殿宇外搭起成片脚手架，可以说 **erect a scaffold — “Workers erected a scaffold around the old temple before beginning the restoration.”**

quiz.question: manifold ________
quiz.explanation: 多种多样的，多种多样的好处。Exercise has manifold benefits for health. 运动对健康有多种多样的好处。 | mani->许多（拉丁manifestus），fold->倍，manifold->许多倍折叠=多种多样的（cf. fold倍/折叠，tenfold十倍，manifold多样） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里人物众多、关系和情感层次复杂，很适合联想到 manifold，可以说 **manifold relationships — “Dream of the Red Chamber portrays the manifold relationships of a vast household, from kinship and friendship to rivalry and romance.”**

quiz.question: behold ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 看见，看见风景。Climb the tower to behold the view. 爬上塔楼看见风景。 | be->完全，hold->抓住（古英语），behold->完全抓住视线=看见（cf. beholder观看者，lo and behold看哪，beauty is in eye of beholder美在观者眼中） || 文化联想：杜甫“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”式的登高远望很适合联想到 behold，可以说 **behold a grand view — “From the summit, the traveler could behold a grand view of mountains stretching to the horizon.”**

quiz.question: withhold _______
quiz.explanation: 扣留，扣留付款。The client decided to withhold payment until completion. 客户决定在完成之前扣留付款。 | with->对抗，hold->持有，withhold->对抗持有=扣留（cf. withdraw撤回，withstand抵抗，withhold不释放） || 文化联想：旧时东家故意压着工钱不发，就是典型的 withhold，可以说 **withhold wages — “The landlord angered the workers by threatening to withhold wages they had already earned.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ foothold
quiz.explanation: 立足点，获得立足点。The company tried to gain a foothold in the market. 公司试图在市场上获得立足点。 | foot->脚，hold->持，foothold->用脚抓住的地方=立足点（cf. toehold初步立足点，stronghold据点，beachhead滩头阵地） || 文化联想：“站稳脚跟”几乎就是 foothold 的直观中文对应，可以说 **gain a foothold — “The merchant first gained a foothold in the southern market through one small but successful shop.”**

quiz.question: mold ______
quiz.explanation: 霉菌，霉菌生长。Damp conditions caused mold growth on the walls. 潮湿的条件导致墙上霉菌生长。 | mold->霉菌（古挪威mygla->长霉），mold->也指模具（两个不同词源，cf. mold模型，moldable可塑，mildew霉菌） || 文化联想：江南梅雨季墙角很容易长霉，可以说 **mold growth — “Weeks of damp weather caused mold growth on the walls of the old house.”**

quiz.question: contraband _____
quiz.explanation: 违禁品，违禁品货物。Customs officials seized contraband goods. 海关官员查获了违禁品货物。 | contra->反对，band->命令（拉丁bannum->禁令），contraband->违反禁令的货物（cf. ban禁令，banish放逐，abandon放弃=离开禁区） || 文化联想：历史上边境私盐、私茶等绕过官府禁令交易的货物可以叫 contraband，可以说 **contraband goods — “Smugglers carried contraband goods such as untaxed salt across remote mountain passes.”**

quiz.question: disband _ _____
quiz.explanation: 解散，解散团体。The organization decided to disband a group. 该组织决定解散团体。 | dis->分开，band->团体，disband->将团体分散=解散（cf. band乐队/团体，band together联合，bond联系） || 文化联想：一个组织被正式撤销、成员各自离开，可以用 disband 来表达，可以说 **disband a group — “After the rebellion ended, the local authorities ordered the armed group to disband.”**

quiz.question: bland ____
quiz.explanation: 清淡的，清淡的饮食。The doctor recommended a bland diet after surgery. 医生建议手术后清淡的饮食。 | blandus->温和（拉丁），bland->温和无刺激的=清淡的（cf. blandish奉承，blandishment甜言蜜语，cf. bland smile温和微笑） || 文化联想：白粥如果没有配菜和调味，中国人常说“淡而无味”，可以说 **bland food — “Plain rice porridge without salt or side dishes can taste like bland food to someone used to stronger flavors.”**

quiz.question: ______ garland
quiz.explanation: 花环，花环。The bride wore a beautiful flower garland. 新娘戴着美丽的花环。 | garland->花环（古法语garlande），garland->花圈装饰（cf. wreath花圈，lei花环夏威夷，chaplet花冠） || 文化联想：端午或传统节庆时，人们会用艾草、花草编成环状装饰，可以联想到 garland，可以说 **a flower garland — “Children made a flower garland and hung it beside the doorway for the festival.”**

quiz.question: ______ hinterland
quiz.explanation: 内陆，偏远的内陆。They explored the remote hinterland. 他们探索了偏远的内陆。 | hinter->后面（德语），land->陆地，hinterland->后方的陆地=内陆/腹地（cf. hinder阻碍，behind在后，landlocked内陆国） || 文化联想：“塞北”“西北腹地”这类远离沿海中心城市的内陆地区很适合联想到 hinterland，可以说 **the western hinterland — “For centuries, caravans crossed China’s western hinterland on routes linking oasis towns and frontier settlements.”**

quiz.question: ____ demand
quiz.explanation: 需求，满足需求。The factory struggled to meet demand. 工厂努力满足需求。 | de->彻底，mand->命令（拉丁mandare），demand->彻底命令=要求（cf. command命令，mandate任务，remand羁押，contraband违禁品） || 文化联想：古代百姓到衙门“讨说法”、要求官府给出处理结果，可以用 demand 来表达，可以说 **demand justice — “The villagers gathered outside the yamen to demand justice after their land had been seized.”**

quiz.question: _____ reprimand
quiz.explanation: 训斥，严厉的训斥。The manager issued a stern reprimand. 经理发出了严厉的训斥。 | re->再，primand->压制（拉丁premere->压），reprimand->再次压制=训斥（cf. repress压制，suppress镇压，command命令） || 文化联想：旧式家塾里先生用戒尺训斥犯错学生的场景很适合联想到 reprimand，可以说 **a stern reprimand — “The teacher gave the boy a stern reprimand for cheating on his lesson.”**

quiz.question: countermand _____
quiz.explanation: 撤销，撤销命令。The general decided to countermand order. 将军决定撤销命令。 | counter->对抗，mand->命令，countermand->用相反命令抵消=撤销（cf. command命令，demand要求，mandate任务，remand羁押） || 文化联想：皇帝下达新诏令撤回前一道命令，就是 countermand 最直观的历史联想，可以说 **countermand an order — “The emperor issued a new decree to countermand the earlier order before it could be carried out.”**
